title: 跟读练习
book: 仁爱科普版 英语 九年级上册

sentences.t: What was *communication* like‿in the *past*?
sentences.zh: 过去的通讯是什么样的？

sentences.t: It was *slow* and *difficult*, and people could‿only *write* letters‿or make phone calls.
sentences.zh: 它又慢又困难，人们只能写信或打电话。

sentences.t: What has *happened* to communication *nowadays*?
sentences.zh: 如今通讯发生了什么变化？

sentences.t: We can get‿in *touch* so *easily* with modern communication.
sentences.zh: 有了现代通讯，我们可以如此轻松地保持联系。

sentences.t: It has become *quick*‿and *easy*.
sentences.zh: 它变得又快又方便。

sentences.t: Hi, guys. I *went* to *London* this *summer*.
sentences.zh: 嗨，伙计们。今年夏天我去了伦敦。

sentences.t: You *know* what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.t: The *air* was *fresh*‿and *clean*.
sentences.zh: 空气清新又干净。

sentences.t: *Really*?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.t: But isn't *London*‿a *fog* city?
sentences.zh: 但伦敦不是雾都吗？

sentences.t: Yes, it *was*.
sentences.zh: 是的，以前是。

sentences.t: In the *1950s*, heavy *smoke*‿and *fog* covered London.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪50年代，浓烟和大雾笼罩着伦敦。

sentences.t: But now, as you travel‿in the UK, you can see *blue* sky, *green* grass‿and *clean* water everywhere.
sentences.zh: 但现在，当你在英国旅行时，到处都能看到蓝天、绿草和清澈的水。

sentences.t: How *wonderful*!
sentences.zh: 太棒了！

sentences.t: This *holiday*, my *parents*‿and I went to Mount *Huangshan*.
sentences.zh: 这个假期，我和父母去了黄山。

sentences.t: *Great* changes have‿also taken place *there*.
sentences.zh: 那里也发生了巨大的变化。

sentences.t: I have *never* been to Mount *Huangshan*.
sentences.zh: 我从没去过黄山。

sentences.t: What *changes*‿are you talking‿about?
sentences.zh: 你说的是什么变化？

sentences.t: Good *order*, green *travel*, everywhere‿is nice‿and *clean*.
sentences.zh: 秩序良好，绿色出行，到处都干净整洁。

sentences.t: As‿a matter‿of fact, *almost* everything‿is changing for the *better*.
sentences.zh: 事实上，几乎一切都在变得更好。

sentences.t: That's *great*!
sentences.zh: 太好了！

sentences.t: I also *noticed* some *improvements* during my travel to the red tourism site, Mount *Jinggangshan*.
sentences.zh: 我去红色旅游景点井冈山旅行时，也注意到了一些改善。

sentences.t: That‿is, the tourist *service*‿is now much *better*.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，那里的旅游服务现在好多了。

sentences.t: *Cool*!
sentences.zh: 酷！

sentences.t: Li Huan, when did you *move* here?
sentences.zh: 李欢，你是什么时候搬到这里的？

sentences.t: *Three* months‿ago.
sentences.zh: 三个月前。

sentences.t: I *remember* you lived‿in the *countryside* with your *grandparents*.
sentences.zh: 我记得你以前和祖父母住在乡下。

sentences.t: Yes, I *did*.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.t: Have your *grandparents* moved here with you, *too*?
sentences.zh: 你的祖父母也和你一起搬来了吗？

sentences.t: No, they don't like the *busy* and *crowded* *city*.
sentences.zh: 没有，他们不喜欢繁忙拥挤的城市。

sentences.t: They *prefer* their *quiet*‿and *simple* life‿in the countryside.
sentences.zh: 他们更喜欢乡下安静简朴的生活。

sentences.t: Well, you can go to *visit* them‿at *any* time.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你可以随时去看望他们。

sentences.t: That's *right*.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.t: It's very *easy* to go there by *bus* now.
sentences.zh: 现在坐公共汽车去那里很方便。

sentences.t: By the way, have you got *used* to the *life*‿in the *city*?
sentences.zh: 顺便问一下，你已经习惯城市生活了吗？

sentences.t: No, I *haven't*.
sentences.zh: 不，还没有。

sentences.t: It's quite *different* here‿and maybe I need some *more* time.
sentences.zh: 这里很不一样，也许我需要更多时间。

sentences.t: Don't *worry*.
sentences.zh: 别担心。

sentences.t: If you have‿any *problem*, I'll be *happy* to *help*.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我很乐意帮忙。

sentences.t: *Thanks*!
sentences.zh: 谢谢！

sentences.t: It's so *nice*‿of you to say that.
sentences.zh: 你这么说真是太好了。

sentences.t: Have you got‿*around*‿in the *city*?
sentences.zh: 你在城里到处逛过了吗？

sentences.t: Not *yet*.
sentences.zh: 还没有。

sentences.t: I have been *busy* with my *studies*.
sentences.zh: 我一直忙于学习。

sentences.t: There's‿a new *sports* center.
sentences.zh: 有一个新的体育中心。

sentences.t: How about going *swimming* together this *weekend*?
sentences.zh: 这个周末一起去游泳怎么样？

sentences.t: Sounds *great*!
sentences.zh: 听起来很棒！

sentences.t: I *grew* up‿in a *small* *town*.
sentences.zh: 我在一个小镇长大。
sentences.tip: 陈述句用降调；up in 连读

sentences.t: Are there‿any *differences* between the two *cities*?
sentences.zh: 这两座城市之间有什么不同吗？
sentences.tip: 一般疑问句用升调；there any 连读（r 音连读）

sentences.t: What‿a *great* change‿in this‿area!
sentences.zh: 这个地区的变化真大啊！
sentences.tip: 感叹句用降调

sentences.t: Have‿a *look*‿at the *picture* taken *30* years‿ago.
sentences.zh: 看看这张30年前拍的照片吧。
sentences.tip: 祈使句用降调；look at、years ago 连读

sentences.t: Grandpa, what did you *usually* do in your *childhood*?
sentences.zh: 爷爷，您小时候通常做什么？
sentences.tip: 特殊疑问句用降调

sentences.t: Well, I *often* played *hide*‿and *seek* with my friends.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我经常和朋友们玩捉迷藏。

sentences.t: Sounds‿*interesting*.
sentences.zh: 听起来很有趣。

sentences.t: What‿other *activities* do you *remember*?
sentences.zh: 您还记得哪些其他活动？

sentences.t: Em, let me *think*... I also watched‿*open-air* movies, listened to the radio and played *chess*‿or cards.
sentences.zh: 嗯，让我想想……我还看过露天电影，听过收音机，下过象棋或打过牌。

sentences.t: My *leisure* activities‿are *nothing* like *yours*.
sentences.zh: 我的休闲活动和您的完全不一样。

sentences.t: I *watch*‿and *play* football matches.
sentences.zh: 我看足球比赛，也踢足球比赛。

sentences.t: On *weekends*, I *surf* the internet‿or go to the *cinema* with my friends.
sentences.zh: 周末，我会上网或和朋友去看电影。

sentences.t: Yes, *many* things have *changed*.
sentences.zh: 是的，很多事情都变了。

sentences.t: *Nowadays*, people have *more* ways to have *fun*.
sentences.zh: 如今，人们有更多的娱乐方式。

sentences.t: I'm *Zhang Lin*.
sentences.zh: 我叫张琳。
我26岁。

sentences.t: I'd like to talk‿about some *changes*‿in my *life* over the years.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈这些年来我生活中的一些变化。

sentences.t: When I was *little*, I lived with my *parents*.
sentences.zh: 我小时候和父母住在一起。

sentences.t: We had meals *together* every *day*.
sentences.zh: 我们每天一起吃饭。

sentences.t: *Now*, I live by *myself*‿and sometimes I don't have *time* for breakfast.
sentences.zh: 现在，我一个人住，有时候没时间吃早餐。

sentences.t: I have to *say* that‿it‿is *not* healthy.
sentences.zh: 我不得不说，这样不健康。

sentences.t: *Another* big *change*‿in my life‿is the way of *shopping*.
sentences.zh: 我生活中的另一个大变化是购物方式。

sentences.t: In the *past*, we went to stores to do shopping, but *today* we can shop‿*online*.
sentences.zh: 过去，我们去商店购物，但现在我们可以网上购物。

sentences.t: I think‿it‿is much *easier*‿and *simpler*.
sentences.zh: 我认为这要容易、简单得多。

sentences.t: I *always* order *fruit*‿and *vegetables*‿on phone‿apps.
sentences.zh: 我总是在手机应用上订购水果和蔬菜。

sentences.t: There‿are so *many* choices, and shopping‿online saves me a lot‿of *time*.
sentences.zh: 选择非常多，而且网上购物为我节省了很多时间。

sentences.t: *China* has made great *achievements* since‿its *opening-up*.
sentences.zh: 自改革开放以来，中国取得了巨大成就。

sentences.t: China has become the world's *second* largest‿*economy*, and people's living conditions have *greatly* improved.
sentences.zh: 中国已成为世界第二大经济体，人们的生活条件也大大改善。

sentences.t: *Also*, China has made great *progress*‿in *science*‿and technology.
sentences.zh: 此外，中国在科学技术方面也取得了巨大进步。

sentences.t: Only a *few* countries have sent people‿into *space*, and *China* is one‿of them.
sentences.zh: 只有少数几个国家把人送入了太空，中国就是其中之一。

sentences.t: China is playing a more and more *important* role‿in *international* events, such‿as keeping world peace, protecting the environment and fighting‿against natural disasters.
sentences.zh: 中国在国际事务中发挥着越来越重要的作用，比如维护世界和平、保护环境和抗击自然灾害。

sentences.t: *Great* changes have taken place‿in *China* since the *1980s*.
sentences.zh: 自20世纪80年代以来，中国发生了巨大变化。

sentences.t: Let's take *Beijing*‿as‿an *example*.
sentences.zh: 我们以北京为例。

sentences.t: I have lived‿in *Beijing* for a *long* time.
sentences.zh: 我在北京生活了很长时间。

sentences.t: I can *feel* how *much* life has *changed*‿in this city.
sentences.zh: 我能感受到这座城市的生活发生了多大的变化。

sentences.t: In the *past*, *big* families were crowded‿into *small* houses.
sentences.zh: 过去，大家庭挤住在狭小的房子里。

sentences.t: They rode *bicycles*‿or took *buses* to and from work.
sentences.zh: 他们骑自行车或乘公共汽车上下班。

sentences.t: The *streets* were *narrow*, and there weren't *many* cars.
sentences.zh: 街道很窄，汽车也不多。

sentences.t: After work, people usually stayed‿at *home* because they didn't have many *leisure* activities to *relax*.
sentences.zh: 下班后，人们通常待在家里，因为他们没有多少休闲活动来放松。

sentences.t: People read *newspapers* to find‿out what was going‿on‿in the *world*.
sentences.zh: 人们通过读报纸了解世界上正在发生的事情。

sentences.t: *Now*, Beijing has *greatly* *changed*.
sentences.zh: 如今，北京发生了巨大变化。

sentences.t: There‿are *large* blocks‿of *modern* apartments.
sentences.zh: 这里有大片的现代化公寓楼。

sentences.t: The city is *bigger* with *wider* streets, and there‿are many *underground* lines‿and lots‿of cars.
sentences.zh: 城市更大了，街道更宽了，还有许多地铁线路和大量汽车。

sentences.t: *Improvements*‿in *technology* have made smart phones very *popular*.
sentences.zh: 科技的进步使智能手机变得非常普及。

sentences.t: People can *chat* with each‿other‿or *enjoy* themselves‿on smart phones.
sentences.zh: 人们可以在智能手机上互相聊天或自娱自乐。

sentences.t: The changes have made *Beijing*‿a *modern* *international* city.
sentences.zh: 这些变化使北京成为一座现代化的国际城市。

sentences.t: *However*, some people find the *old* days more *fun*.
sentences.zh: 然而，有些人觉得过去的日子更有趣。

sentences.t: At that time, people were *closer*, and life was *simpler*‿and *slower*.
sentences.zh: 那时候，人与人之间更亲近，生活也更简单、更慢。

sentences.t: In‿any *case*, we should keep‿up with the *changing* *world*.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，我们都应该跟上这个不断变化的世界。

sentences.t: Now people can spend their *free* time‿in the new *amusement* park near their *community*.
sentences.zh: 现在人们可以在社区附近的新游乐园里度过空闲时间。
sentences.tip: 后缀 -ment 读 /mənt/，弱读不重读

sentences.t: With the *improvement*‿of the *environment*, people now have led a *better* life than before.
sentences.zh: 随着环境的改善，人们现在过上了比以前更好的生活。

sentences.t: In recent years, China has made great *achievements*‿in *science*‿and *technology*.
sentences.zh: 近年来，中国在科学技术方面取得了巨大成就。

sentences.t: Hi, Kangkang! I *haven't* seen you for a couple‿of *days*.
sentences.zh: 嗨，康康！我好几天没见到你了。

sentences.t: Where have you *been*?
sentences.zh: 你去哪儿了？

sentences.t: I have *just* come back from my *hometown*.
sentences.zh: 我刚从老家回来。

sentences.t: A lot‿of *changes* have taken place *there*.
sentences.zh: 那里发生了很多变化。

sentences.t: It has become *more* *beautiful*.
sentences.zh: 它变得更美了。

sentences.t: *Great*!
sentences.zh: 太好了！

sentences.t: By the way, have you *seen* Xiao Ya *recently*?
sentences.zh: 顺便问一下，你最近见过小雅吗？

sentences.t: No, she has *gone* to *Guangzhou* with her *parents*.
sentences.zh: 没有，她和父母去广州了。

sentences.t: She *hasn't* come back *yet*.
sentences.zh: 她还没回来。

sentences.t: Today, we have the *pleasure*‿of inviting Mr. *Li* to share his *leisure* activities.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们很高兴邀请到李先生来分享他的休闲活动。

sentences.t: Thank you for *joining*‿us, Mr. *Li*.
sentences.zh: 感谢您的参与，李先生。

sentences.t: *Thank* you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.t: My *leisure* activities have changed *greatly* since my *childhood*.
sentences.zh: 从我小时候到现在，我的休闲活动发生了很大变化。

sentences.t: Could you give‿an *example*?
sentences.zh: 您能举个例子吗？

sentences.t: During my *childhood*, transportation was *not* convenient, so we could‿only travel *near*‿our hometown.
sentences.zh: 在我小时候，交通不便，所以我们只能在家乡附近旅行。

sentences.t: And what‿about *now*?
sentences.zh: 那现在呢？

sentences.t: *Now*, I can travel throughout *China* and‿even‿*abroad*.
sentences.zh: 现在，我可以走遍全中国，甚至出国旅行。

sentences.t: Where‿are you planning to go *next* year?
sentences.zh: 您明年打算去哪儿？

sentences.t: I would like to visit *France* next year.
sentences.zh: 我明年想去法国。

sentences.t: I want to see the *Eiffel* *Tower*‿in *person*.
sentences.zh: 我想亲眼看看埃菲尔铁塔。

sentences.t: What‿else do you *like* to do?
sentences.zh: 您还喜欢做什么？

sentences.t: Well, I *really* enjoy watching *movies*.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我真的很喜欢看电影。

sentences.t: *Before*, we could‿only see a movie on the *playground*.
sentences.zh: 以前，我们只能在操场上看电影。

sentences.t: *Now*, we can go to the *cinema*.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们可以去电影院。

sentences.t: We can sit *comfortably* and *enjoy* the movie.
sentences.zh: 我们可以舒舒服服地坐着欣赏电影。

sentences.t: *Anything*‿else?
sentences.zh: 还有别的吗？

sentences.t: I used to play *Chinese* *chess* with my *neighbors*.
sentences.zh: 我过去常和邻居下象棋。

sentences.t: And how about *now*?
sentences.zh: 那现在呢？

sentences.t: Now I can play with *people* from all‿around the *world*‿on the internet.
sentences.zh: 现在我可以在网上和来自世界各地的人下棋。

sentences.t: Wow. How *amazing*!
sentences.zh: 哇，太神奇了！

sentences.t: As society *develops*, people's *leisure* activities have changed *greatly*.
sentences.zh: 随着社会的发展，人们的休闲活动发生了很大的变化。

sentences.t: In the *past*, watching movies‿outdoors was a *popular*‿and *exciting* leisure activity for people‿of all ages.
sentences.zh: 过去，露天看电影是一项深受各年龄段人们喜爱、令人兴奋的休闲活动。

sentences.t: *Most* people considered such‿experiences *unforgettable*.
sentences.zh: 大多数人认为这样的经历令人难忘。

sentences.t: Another *important* leisure activity was *traveling*.
sentences.zh: 另一项重要的休闲活动是旅行。

sentences.t: Because *most* people did *not* have a lot‿of *money*, they usually hung‿out near their homes.
sentences.zh: 因为大多数人没有很多钱，他们通常在家附近游玩。

sentences.t: *Many* of them loved to go to the *parks*.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人喜欢去公园。

sentences.t: They could have *picnics*‿or row *boats* there.
sentences.zh: 他们可以在那里野餐或划船。

sentences.t: *Now*, people have *more* *choices* for leisure activities.
sentences.zh: 现在，人们的休闲活动有了更多选择。

sentences.t: Many people can *afford* to travel to *many* *different* places far‿away from their homes.
sentences.zh: 许多人有能力去远离家乡的许多不同地方旅行。

sentences.t: On *weekends*, families can go on *road* trips‿in their *own* cars.
sentences.zh: 周末，家庭可以开着自己的车去自驾游。

sentences.t: How time *flies*!
sentences.zh: 时间过得真快啊！

sentences.t: It has been *nearly* 2 *years* since you went to *Canada* for further study.
sentences.zh: 自从你去加拿大深造，已经快两年了。

sentences.t: How is *everything* going?
sentences.zh: 一切都还好吗？

sentences.t: We all *miss* you very *much*.
sentences.zh: 我们都很想你。

sentences.t: In your *last* letter, you said you missed‿our *middle* school.
sentences.zh: 你在上一封信中说你想念我们的中学。

sentences.t: So, here‿in this email, I send you some *pictures*‿of‿it.
sentences.zh: 所以，在这封邮件里，我给你发了一些学校的照片。

sentences.t: You must be *surprised*‿at how *much* the school has *changed*.
sentences.zh: 你一定会惊讶于学校变化之大。

sentences.t: Our middle school built‿a new *dining* hall—the *white* building‿in the picture.
sentences.zh: 我们中学新建了一座食堂——就是照片里那座白色的建筑。

sentences.t: It serves *different* kinds‿of *healthy* food‿at noon, and the students needn't go back home to have *lunch*.
sentences.zh: 它中午供应各种健康食品，学生们不用回家吃午饭了。

sentences.t: Can you see the new *playground*?
sentences.zh: 你能看到新操场吗？

sentences.t: It will be *ready* for use this *week*.
sentences.zh: 它这周就能投入使用了。

sentences.t: It gives‿our school a *new* *look*.
sentences.zh: 它让我们学校焕然一新。

sentences.t: It will be so much *easier* to hold‿events such‿as *flag* raising‿and *PE* lessons.
sentences.zh: 举行升旗仪式、上体育课等活动会方便得多。

sentences.t: My classmates‿and I *can't* wait to have *PE* lessons *here*.
sentences.zh: 我和同学们都迫不及待地想在这里上体育课了。

sentences.t: There‿are so *many* changes‿in‿our *school*.
sentences.zh: 我们学校有这么多变化。

sentences.t: I *hope* you'll come back *home* this winter vacation to see and *experience* for yourself.
sentences.zh: 我希望你今年寒假回家亲自来看看、感受一下。

sentences.t: Take *good* care‿of *yourself*.
sentences.zh: 照顾好自己。

sentences.t: How do people *communicate* with each‿other‿in the *information*‿era?
sentences.zh: 在信息时代，人们是如何相互交流的？

sentences.t: Well, *first*, it's kind‿of *strange*.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，这有点奇怪。

sentences.t: We can have‿a *whole* conversation with someone without‿actually *talking*.
sentences.zh: 我们可以和别人进行一整段对话，却根本不用开口说话。

sentences.t: For‿example, we can send‿a message with just‿a *look*, a *touch*, or even a *smile*.
sentences.zh: 例如，我们可以只用一个眼神、一次触碰甚至一个微笑来传递信息。

sentences.t: And then, there's *texting*‿and *social* media.
sentences.zh: 然后，还有短信和社交媒体。

sentences.t: With them, we can *share*‿our thoughts‿and *feelings* without saying a word‿out *loud*.
sentences.zh: 通过它们，我们无需大声说出一个字就能分享自己的想法和感受。

sentences.t: It's like we are creating a *whole* *new* *language*.
sentences.zh: 就像我们正在创造一门全新的语言。

sentences.t: And we can *connect* with each‿other‿in so many *different* ways, even when we're *not* in the same room.
sentences.zh: 而且，即使我们不在同一个房间，也可以通过许多不同的方式相互联系。

sentences.t: Isn't‿it *amazing*?
sentences.zh: 这难道不令人惊叹吗？
sentences.tip: 反问句表达感叹，通常用降调

sentences.t: But sometimes, I *wonder*‿if we're *really* saying what we *mean*.
sentences.zh: 但有时候，我怀疑我们是否真的在表达自己的意思。

sentences.t: Or even *worse*, we're probably just *hiding* behind the screens‿and symbols, receiving *false* information‿instead‿of really talking to someone.
sentences.zh: 更糟的是，我们可能只是躲在屏幕和符号背后，接收虚假信息，而不是真正地与人交谈。

sentences.t: What's the lock *made*‿of?
sentences.zh: 这把锁是用什么做的？

sentences.t: It‿is made‿of *metal*.
sentences.zh: 它是用金属做的。

sentences.t: What‿is‿it *used* for?
sentences.zh: 它是用来做什么的？

sentences.t: It‿is used for *locking* the *door*.
sentences.zh: 它是用来锁门的。

sentences.t: What do you use the *laptop* for?
sentences.zh: 你用笔记本电脑做什么？

sentences.t: For *work*‿and *play*.
sentences.zh: 用来工作和娱乐。

sentences.t: *Great*.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.t: Do you know what *laptops*‿are *made*‿of?
sentences.zh: 你知道笔记本电脑是用什么做的吗？

sentences.t: *Plastic*‿and *metal*.
sentences.zh: 塑料和金属。

sentences.t: Laptops‿are *light*‿and *thin*, so it's *easy* to take them‿around.
sentences.zh: 笔记本电脑又轻又薄，所以随身携带很方便。

sentences.t: I heard that the laptop was first made‿in *America* around *1981*.
sentences.zh: 我听说笔记本电脑大约在1981年首次在美国制造出来。

sentences.t: Is that *so*?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.t: *Yes*.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.t: Hi, Kangkang. What do you use the *cellphone* for?
sentences.zh: 嗨，康康。你用手机做什么？

sentences.t: *Mostly* for *communication*.
sentences.zh: 主要用来沟通交流。

sentences.t: Sometimes I‿also use‿it to *search* for *information*.
sentences.zh: 有时候我也用它来搜索信息。

sentences.t: Do you know what the *cellphone*‿is *made*‿of?
sentences.zh: 你知道手机是用什么做的吗？

sentences.t: *Mainly* *plastic*.
sentences.zh: 主要是塑料。

sentences.t: And that's why cellphones‿are so *light*.
sentences.zh: 这就是手机这么轻的原因。

sentences.t: Do you know *when* the cellphone was *developed*?
sentences.zh: 你知道手机是什么时候研制出来的吗？

sentences.t: I think the cellphone was developed‿in *1976*, but Lingling said‿it was developed‿in *1973*.
sentences.zh: 我以为手机是1976年研制出来的，但玲玲说是1973年。

sentences.t: Lingling‿is *right*.
sentences.zh: 玲玲说得对。

sentences.t: The cellphone was developed‿in *1973*‿in *America*.
sentences.zh: 手机是1973年在美国研制出来的。

sentences.t: Oh, I *see*.
sentences.zh: 哦，我明白了。

sentences.t: Look! A light *bulb*!
sentences.zh: 看！一个电灯泡！

sentences.t: Yeah. It‿is said that‿it was invented‿in *1879*.
sentences.zh: 是啊。据说它是1879年发明的。

sentences.t: Do you know *who* the *inventor*‿is?
sentences.zh: 你知道发明者是谁吗？

sentences.t: Thomas *Edison*.
sentences.zh: 托马斯·爱迪生。

sentences.t: He brought‿us *light*‿at *night* with his‿invention.
sentences.zh: 他的发明给我们带来了夜晚的光明。

sentences.t: He invented more than two *thousand* things‿in his *whole* life.
sentences.zh: 他一生发明了两千多样东西。

sentences.t: Yes. That's what makes him *famous*‿all over the *world*.
sentences.zh: 是的。这就是他闻名世界的原因。

sentences.t: Wait ... Is that‿a *telephone*?
sentences.zh: 等等……那是电话吗？

sentences.t: That's *right*.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.t: Well, the *first* telephone was‿invented by Alexander Graham *Bell*‿in *1876*.
sentences.zh: 嗯，第一部电话是亚历山大·格雷厄姆·贝尔在1876年发明的。

sentences.t: *Cool*.
sentences.zh: 真酷。

sentences.t: Over‿a *hundred* years‿ago, people could already *talk* over‿a *distance*.
sentences.zh: 一百多年前，人们就已经能够远距离通话了。

sentences.t: *Yes*.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.t: Is that‿a *bike*?
sentences.zh: 那是一辆自行车吗？

sentences.t: No, it's the *first* *car*.
sentences.zh: 不，那是第一辆汽车。

sentences.t: It was‿invented by Karl *Benz*‿in *1885*.
sentences.zh: 它是卡尔·本茨在1885年发明的。

sentences.t: I *see*.
sentences.zh: 我明白了。

sentences.t: It must be a lot more *convenient* to travel‿in *cars* than‿on *horses*.
sentences.zh: 坐汽车出行一定比骑马方便得多。

sentences.t: These great‿inventions have *truly* *changed* the world, haven't they?
sentences.zh: 这些伟大的发明真正改变了世界，不是吗？
sentences.tip: 有把握时降调；真心想确认时用升调

sentences.t: They *certainly* have.
sentences.zh: 当然是。

sentences.t: The light bulb was‿*invented* by Thomas *Edison*.
sentences.zh: 电灯泡是由托马斯·爱迪生发明的。
sentences.tip: 按意群停顿：The light bulb was invented / by Thomas Edison.

sentences.t: The light bulb was‿*invented* by Thomas *Edison*‿in *1879*.
sentences.zh: 电灯泡是由托马斯·爱迪生在1879年发明的。
sentences.tip: 按意群停顿：The light bulb was invented / by Thomas Edison / in 1879.

sentences.t: As we know, the light bulb was‿*invented* by Thomas *Edison*‿in *1879*.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，电灯泡是由托马斯·爱迪生在1879年发明的。
sentences.tip: 按意群停顿：As we know, / the light bulb was invented / by Thomas Edison / in 1879.

sentences.t: There‿are‿a *few* *steps* to *follow*.
sentences.zh: 有几个步骤要遵循。
sentences.tip: 按意群停顿：There are a few steps / to follow.

sentences.t: There are‿a few *steps* to *follow*‿in the *invention* process.
sentences.zh: 在发明过程中有几个步骤要遵循。
sentences.tip: 按意群停顿：There are a few steps / to follow / in the invention process.

sentences.t: The *scientist* tells‿us there are‿a few *steps* to follow‿in the *invention* process.
sentences.zh: 科学家告诉我们，在发明过程中有几个步骤要遵循。
sentences.tip: 按意群停顿：The scientist tells us / there are a few steps / to follow / in the invention process.

sentences.t: We're *inventors*.
sentences.zh: 我们是发明家。
sentences.tip: 重音在 'inventors 的第二音节 ven 上。

sentences.t: We have made *great* *inventions* since‿our *birth*.
sentences.zh: 从出生起我们就做出了伟大的发明。
sentences.tip: 节奏：We have made 'great 'inventions / since our 'birth.

sentences.t: Our‿inventions can go *slow* or *really* *fast*.
sentences.zh: 我们的发明可以走得很慢，也可以非常快。
sentences.tip: 节奏：Our 'inventions can go 'slow / or 'really 'fast.

sentences.t: And there‿are some *inventions* from the *past*.
sentences.zh: 还有一些来自过去的发明。

sentences.t: Our *machines* go over *land* and through the air, Our inventions can take‿us *anywhere*!
sentences.zh: 我们的机器穿越陆地，飞越天空，我们的发明能带我们去任何地方！
sentences.tip: 重读词：'machines, 'land, 'air, 'take, 'anywhere；在 air 后稍作停顿。

sentences.t: Our‿inventions *fly* us *high* and *far*‿away!
sentences.zh: 我们的发明带我们飞得又高又远！

sentences.t: And‿our inventions‿are *here* to *stay*!
sentences.zh: 我们的发明会永远留存！

sentences.t: The ancient Greek philosopher *Plato* once said, "*Need* is the *mother*‿of‿invention."
sentences.zh: 古希腊哲学家柏拉图曾说过：“需要是发明之母。”

sentences.t: This means that‿a *need* or‿a *problem* encourages *creative* efforts to meet the need or solve the problem.
sentences.zh: 这意味着需要或问题会激励人们付出创造性的努力，去满足需要或解决问题。

sentences.t: For‿example, the need for *communication* brought‿about the *telephone*, and the need for *entertainment* led to the creation‿of the television.
sentences.zh: 例如，交流的需要带来了电话，娱乐的需要促成了电视的发明。

sentences.t: To solve the problem‿of *seeing*‿in the *dark*, people‿invented the light *bulb*.
sentences.zh: 为了解决在黑暗中看见东西的问题，人们发明了电灯泡。

sentences.t: Philo Farnsworth was‿an *American* *inventor*.
sentences.zh: 菲洛·法恩斯沃思是一位美国发明家。

sentences.t: From‿an *early* age, he showed great *interest*‿in *television*.
sentences.zh: 他从小就对电视表现出浓厚的兴趣。

sentences.t: He believed that machines were *too* *slow* to process‿images.
sentences.zh: 他认为机器处理图像的速度太慢了。

sentences.t: Only an *electronic* system could do that *fast*‿enough.
sentences.zh: 只有电子系统才能足够快地做到这一点。

sentences.t: In *1927*, he invented the *all-electronic* television system.
sentences.zh: 1927年，他发明了全电子电视系统。

sentences.t: Can you explain how‿a *discovery* is *different* from‿an *invention*?
sentences.zh: 你能解释一下发现和发明有什么不同吗？

sentences.t: Take Christopher Columbus' *discovery* of America and Thomas Edison's *invention*‿of the light bulb as‿examples.
sentences.zh: 以克里斯托弗·哥伦布发现美洲和托马斯·爱迪生发明电灯泡为例。

sentences.t: Columbus *discovered* land, but the land *existed* long before he found‿it.
sentences.zh: 哥伦布发现了陆地，但那片陆地在他发现之前早就存在了。

sentences.t: However, in Edison's case, there was *no* light bulb‿in the world before Edison *created*‿it.
sentences.zh: 然而，就爱迪生而言，在他创造出电灯泡之前，世界上根本没有电灯泡。

sentences.t: Now, do you see the *difference*?
sentences.zh: 现在，你明白其中的区别了吗？

sentences.t: For‿a very *long* time, Chinese science and technology held‿a *leading* position‿in the world.
sentences.zh: 很长一段时间里，中国的科学技术在世界上处于领先地位。

sentences.t: A good‿example is the *four* great inventions‿of *ancient* China: paper-making, compass, gunpowder‿and printing.
sentences.zh: 一个很好的例子就是中国古代四大发明：造纸术、指南针、火药和印刷术。

sentences.t: Before paper was‿invented, people wrote‿on *heavy* bamboos‿and *expensive* silk.
sentences.zh: 在纸发明之前，人们在笨重的竹简和昂贵的丝绸上写字。

sentences.t: During the Eastern Han Dynasty, *paper-making* technology was‿*improved* by Cai Lun.
sentences.zh: 东汉时期，蔡伦改进了造纸技术。

sentences.t: He made the paper from *cheaper* materials, such‿as fishing *nets*‿and *ropes*.
sentences.zh: 他用渔网、绳子等更便宜的材料造纸。

sentences.t: As‿a result, it became *easier* to make *books*.
sentences.zh: 因此，制作书籍变得更容易了。

sentences.t: Before the compass was used for *sailing*, sailors‿around the world had to depend‿on *stars* to find the right *direction*.
sentences.zh: 在指南针用于航海之前，世界各地的水手只能依靠星星来辨别方向。

sentences.t: In the Northern Song Dynasty, the *compass* was then‿*invented*.
sentences.zh: 北宋时期，指南针被发明出来。

sentences.t: It was made by putting‿a *magnetic* *needle* on "luopan", a wooden *disk*.
sentences.zh: 它是把一根磁针放在一个叫“罗盘”的木制圆盘上制成的。

sentences.t: In‿ancient China, *gunpowder* was‿invented by *accident*.
sentences.zh: 在中国古代，火药是偶然被发明的。

sentences.t: At first, it was used‿in *fireworks*.
sentences.zh: 起初，它被用于烟花爆竹。

sentences.t: At the end‿of the Tang Dynasty, people began to use‿it‿in *wars*.
sentences.zh: 唐朝末年，人们开始把它用于战争。

sentences.t: The technology of making gunpowder was brought to the *Arabic* world‿and *Europe*‿in the 13th century.
sentences.zh: 制造火药的技术在13世纪传到了阿拉伯世界和欧洲。

sentences.t: Chinese people used *block* *printing* to produce books‿at first.
sentences.zh: 中国人起初用雕版印刷来印制书籍。

sentences.t: This technology *wasted* many *wooden* boards.
sentences.zh: 这种技术浪费了许多木板。

sentences.t: During the Northern Song Dynasty, Bi Sheng developed *movable* type *printing*.
sentences.zh: 北宋时期，毕昇发明了活字印刷术。

sentences.t: He made characters‿on special *soil* pieces so that they could be *reused* later to print‿other books.
sentences.zh: 他把字刻在特制的泥块上，这样以后就可以重复使用来印刷其他书籍。

sentences.t: The invention helped *spread* *knowledge*‿around the world.
sentences.zh: 这项发明帮助知识传遍了世界。

sentences.t: The four great‿inventions were *gifts* from *China* to the world.
sentences.zh: 四大发明是中国献给世界的礼物。

sentences.t: Together they *speeded*‿up the *development*‿of human society.
sentences.zh: 它们共同加快了人类社会的发展。

sentences.t: In the old days, *stone* was *difficult* to transport, so many *wooden* houses were built.
sentences.zh: 在过去，石头很难运输，所以人们建造了许多木房子。
sentences.tip: wooden = wood + -en，“木制的”。

sentences.t: Television can *enrich* people's lives‿and *broaden* their minds.
sentences.zh: 电视能丰富人们的生活，开阔人们的视野。
sentences.tip: broaden = broad + -en，“使变宽，拓宽”。

sentences.t: It was one‿of the *greatest* inventions‿in the *20th* century.
sentences.zh: 它是20世纪最伟大的发明之一。

sentences.t: Around *2000* BCE, *woolen* clothing‿appeared‿in China.
sentences.zh: 大约公元前2000年，羊毛衣物在中国出现。
sentences.tip: woolen = wool + -en，“羊毛制的”。

sentences.t: Hi, Kangkang, why do you look so *tired*?
sentences.zh: 嗨，康康，你为什么看起来这么累？

sentences.t: I was *woken*‿up by my *mom* too *early* this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上我妈妈很早就把我叫醒了。

sentences.t: You stayed‿up *late* last *night*, right?
sentences.zh: 你昨晚熬夜了，对吧？
sentences.tip: 有把握时降调；真心想确认时用升调

sentences.t: Yes, I *did*.
sentences.zh: 是的，我熬夜了。

sentences.t: I made‿a model *rocket* last night.
sentences.zh: 我昨晚做了一个火箭模型。

sentences.t: It was made for the model rocket *show* this *Sunday*.
sentences.zh: 它是为这个星期天的火箭模型展做的。

sentences.t: Kangkang, what do you think‿is the *greatest* *invention*‿in the world?
sentences.zh: 康康，你认为世界上最伟大的发明是什么？

sentences.t: Em ... *noodles*!
sentences.zh: 嗯……面条！

sentences.t: They are‿an *important* part‿of *traditional* Chinese food‿and they are so *delicious*.
sentences.zh: 它们是中国传统食物的重要组成部分，而且非常美味。

sentences.t: I *agree*.
sentences.zh: 我同意。

sentences.t: You can find *thousands*‿of *different* kinds‿of them.
sentences.zh: 你能找到成千上万种不同的面条。

sentences.t: *Right*.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.t: Noodles were‿invented during the *Han* Dynasty in China, but *nobody* knows who invented them.
sentences.zh: 面条是中国汉朝时发明的，但没有人知道是谁发明的。

sentences.t: And now they become *more*‿and *more* *popular*.
sentences.zh: 而且现在它们越来越受欢迎。

sentences.t: What‿invention do you think‿is *important*?
sentences.zh: 你认为什么发明很重要？

sentences.t: *Stamp*.
sentences.zh: 邮票。

sentences.t: The *first* stamp was‿invented‿in *Britain*.
sentences.zh: 第一枚邮票是在英国发明的。

sentences.t: Do you know *when*‿it was‿invented?
sentences.zh: 你知道它是什么时候发明的吗？

sentences.t: It was‿invented‿in *1837*, by Sir Rowland *Hill*‿in Britain.
sentences.zh: 它是1837年由英国的罗兰·希尔爵士发明的。

sentences.t: It *changed* the way of *communication* and made mailing letters‿easier‿and more *popular*.
sentences.zh: 它改变了通信方式，使寄信变得更容易、更普及。

sentences.t: Yes, the stamps can *record* *history* and *nature*‿in‿a small piece‿of paper.
sentences.zh: 是的，邮票能在一小张纸上记录历史和自然。

sentences.t: That's *true*.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.t: And now many people collect stamps‿as‿a *hobby*.
sentences.zh: 而且现在很多人把集邮当作爱好。

sentences.t: Do you want to be an *inventor*?
sentences.zh: 你想成为一名发明家吗？

sentences.t: Here‿are some *suggestions* to help you.
sentences.zh: 这里有一些建议可以帮助你。

sentences.t: First‿of‿all, you can start with *finding*‿a *problem*.
sentences.zh: 首先，你可以从发现问题开始。

sentences.t: The problem can be *anything* from your *life*‿or *work*.
sentences.zh: 问题可以是你生活或工作中的任何事情。

sentences.t: *Look*‿around you.
sentences.zh: 看看你的周围。

sentences.t: Can you make‿any *improvements*?
sentences.zh: 你能做出什么改进吗？

sentences.t: Perhaps‿an *idea* for‿an invention is‿on your *way*.
sentences.zh: 也许一个发明的点子就在你身边。

sentences.t: Next, you should have‿a *good* *plan*.
sentences.zh: 接下来，你应该有一个好的计划。

sentences.t: Draw out your *ideas* on‿a piece‿of paper and make a *list*‿of things to be done.
sentences.zh: 把你的想法画在一张纸上，并列出要做的事情。

sentences.t: After you have made‿a plan, it's time to *carry*‿it‿*out*.
sentences.zh: 制订好计划后，就该把它付诸实施了。

sentences.t: If you have some *difficulties*, ask for *help* from your friends, parents‿and teachers.
sentences.zh: 如果遇到困难，就向你的朋友、父母和老师寻求帮助。

sentences.t: *Never* give‿up and keep‿on *trying*!
sentences.zh: 永不放弃，坚持尝试！

sentences.t: Difficulties‿are just *stepping* stones toward *success*.
sentences.zh: 困难只是通往成功的垫脚石。

sentences.t: Now, are you *ready* to get‿*started*?
sentences.zh: 现在，你准备好开始了吗？

sentences.t: If you dream *big* and work *hard*, you can‿also become‿a *great* inventor.
sentences.zh: 如果你敢于梦想、努力工作，你也能成为一名伟大的发明家。

sentences.t: Creative‿inventors have *imaginative* *minds*.
sentences.zh: 有创造力的发明家都有富于想象的头脑。

sentences.t: Scientists have found that *daydreaming* can lead to *creative* *imagination*.
sentences.zh: 科学家发现，白日梦能激发创造性的想象力。

sentences.t: It‿is *not* related to the task‿at *hand*.
sentences.zh: 它与手头的任务无关。

sentences.t: For‿example, while working‿on a *math* problem, your mind may *replay* a conversation with a friend, or during a boring meeting, you might find yourself *daydreaming* about a ball game or something‿else.
sentences.zh: 例如，在做数学题时，你的脑海里可能会重现和朋友的一次对话；或者在一场无聊的会议上，你可能会发现自己在幻想一场球赛或别的什么。

sentences.t: Don't *worry*!
sentences.zh: 别担心！

sentences.t: This happens to *everyone* quite‿*often*.
sentences.zh: 这种事每个人都经常发生。

sentences.t: Moreover, daydreaming can make you more *creative* and help you have more *amazing* new ideas.
sentences.zh: 而且，白日梦能让你更有创造力，帮你产生更多奇妙的新点子。

sentences.t: So, keep‿on *imagining*‿and *creating*!
sentences.zh: 所以，继续想象和创造吧！

sentences.t: You might just be the *next* great *writer*‿or *inventor*!
sentences.zh: 你也许就是下一位伟大的作家或发明家！

sentences.t: Katherine Wu went‿on‿a *holiday* with her family to *Florida*.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳·吴和家人去佛罗里达度假。

sentences.t: During the journey, she noticed her dad sometimes trying very *hard* to stay *awake*‿at the *wheel*.
sentences.zh: 在旅途中，她注意到爸爸开车时有时要非常努力才能保持清醒。

sentences.t: Katherine decided to *invent*‿a *machine*.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳决定发明一台机器。

sentences.t: And‿it could keep drivers‿*awake* while they were *driving*‿on the road.
sentences.zh: 它能让司机在路上开车时保持清醒。

sentences.t: After‿a lot‿of *research* and *testings*, she *finally* completed her invention.
sentences.zh: 经过大量的研究和测试，她终于完成了她的发明。

sentences.t: The machine would play *music* to *wake* drivers‿up when they want to *sleep*‿on the road.
sentences.zh: 当司机在路上想睡觉时，这台机器会播放音乐把他们唤醒。

sentences.t: Later, her teacher, Dr. Jesse Miller, helped her *improve* the machine.
sentences.zh: 后来，她的老师杰西·米勒博士帮助她改进了这台机器。

sentences.t: It became more *user-friendly* and *helpful*.
sentences.zh: 它变得更加方便使用、更有用。

sentences.t: Katherine's‿invention won several *prizes*‿in *competitions*.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳的发明在比赛中获得了好几个奖项。

sentences.t: It drew *great* *interest* from many people.
sentences.zh: 它引起了许多人的极大兴趣。

sentences.t: The machine has become‿an *important* tool‿in *reducing* traffic‿accidents.
sentences.zh: 这台机器已成为减少交通事故的重要工具。

sentences.t: Katherine will *continue* her journey on *invention*.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳将继续她的发明之旅。

sentences.t: She hopes that her‿inventions will help make the world‿a *safer* and more *convenient* place.
sentences.zh: 她希望她的发明能让世界变得更安全、更便利。

sentences.t: The invention‿of *jeans* is‿a great *breakthrough* in the world‿of clothing.
sentences.zh: 牛仔裤的发明是服装界的一大突破。

sentences.t: The first jeans were designed‿in *1855*, to be worn by *men*‿as *work* clothes.
sentences.zh: 第一条牛仔裤设计于1855年，是给男人当工作服穿的。

sentences.t: It could take‿up *ten* years to wear‿out a pair‿of jeans.
sentences.zh: 一条牛仔裤可以穿上十年才会磨破。

sentences.t: Today jeans are designed not‿only for *men*, but‿also for *women*‿and *children*.
sentences.zh: 如今，牛仔裤不仅为男人设计，也为女人和孩子设计。

sentences.t: The cloth for making jeans‿is‿also *softer*‿and more comfortable, and the more you *wash* them, the more *comfortable* they become.
sentences.zh: 制作牛仔裤的布料也更柔软、更舒适，而且越洗越舒服。

sentences.t: What's more, there‿are plenty of *choices*‿in *style*‿and *price*.
sentences.zh: 而且，在款式和价格上都有很多选择。

sentences.t: It‿is *easier* than‿ever to find cheap‿and *comfortable* jeans while staying in *fashion*.
sentences.zh: 如今比以往任何时候都更容易找到既便宜又舒适又时尚的牛仔裤。

sentences.t: That's why jeans‿are so *popular*‿all‿over the world now.
sentences.zh: 这就是牛仔裤如今在全世界如此流行的原因。

units.name: Unit 3 绿色地球，美好家园
units.en: A Green Earth, a Better Home

sentences.t: You look *serious*.
sentences.zh: 你看起来很严肃。

sentences.t: What has *happened*?
sentences.zh: 发生什么事了？

sentences.t: I've read‿an *article* about *water* pollution.
sentences.zh: 我读了一篇关于水污染的文章。

sentences.t: What does it *say*?
sentences.zh: 文章里说了什么？

sentences.t: Unsafe water has made many people *sick* in the past few years and water *pollution* is putting our *health*‿at risk.
sentences.zh: 在过去几年里，不安全的水让许多人生病，水污染正使我们的健康面临危险。

sentences.t: I have a long *neck* and I'm the *tallest*‿animal in the world.
sentences.zh: 我有长长的脖子，我是世界上最高的动物。

sentences.t: I like eating *leaves*‿on the *tall* trees.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢吃高高的树上的叶子。

sentences.t: There used to be *fewer* trees and I was always *hungry*.
sentences.zh: 过去树比较少，我总是饿肚子。

sentences.t: Now, I have *enough* leaves to eat because people have *planted* trees‿everywhere.
sentences.zh: 现在我有足够的叶子吃了，因为人们到处都种上了树。

sentences.t: I can *fly*‿in the *sky* like‿a kite and bring you good *luck*.
sentences.zh: 我能像风筝一样在天空中飞翔，还能给你带来好运。

sentences.t: Several years‿ago, I *couldn't* find *trees* to live‿in.
sentences.zh: 几年前，我找不到可以栖息的树。

sentences.t: But recently, people have *stopped* cutting down *trees* and I can find‿a good place to live‿in and start‿a *family*.
sentences.zh: 但最近人们不再砍树了，我能找到好地方安家、生儿育女了。

sentences.t: I am very *big* and I live‿in the *sea*.
sentences.zh: 我的体型很大，生活在大海里。

sentences.t: In the past, *water* pollution was‿a big *problem*.
sentences.zh: 过去，水污染是个大问题。

sentences.t: In recent years, I have seen people's *efforts* to make the sea *clean*‿again.
sentences.zh: 近几年，我看到了人们为让大海重新变干净所做的努力。

sentences.t: Hi, Kangkang. You have *volunteered*‿in an *environmental* organization since last year.
sentences.zh: 你好，康康。从去年起你就在一个环保组织做志愿者。

sentences.t: What's your *job* there?
sentences.zh: 你在那里做什么工作？

sentences.t: I helped *spread* the *message*‿about environmental *protection*.
sentences.zh: 我帮忙宣传有关环境保护的理念。

sentences.t: What *message*?
sentences.zh: 什么理念？

sentences.t: Can you give me any *instructions*?
sentences.zh: 你能给我讲讲具体做法吗？

sentences.t: The message‿is *mainly* about the *three* Rs.
sentences.zh: 这个理念主要是关于“3R”原则的。

sentences.t: Pardon? The three *what*?
sentences.zh: 什么？三个什么？
sentences.tip: 没听清、请对方重复时，追问句常用升调。

sentences.t: The three Rs—*reduce*, *reuse* and *recycle*.
sentences.zh: “3R”就是减量、再利用和回收。

sentences.t: Sounds *interesting*!
sentences.zh: 听起来很有意思！

sentences.t: Can you *explain*‿a bit?
sentences.zh: 你能解释一下吗？

sentences.t: Sure. To *reduce* means trying to produce *less* *trash*.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。减量就是尽量少制造垃圾。

sentences.t: For‿example, we can reduce trash by using *fewer* *plastic* bags.
sentences.zh: 例如，我们可以通过少用塑料袋来减少垃圾。

sentences.t: I see. What‿about *reusing*?
sentences.zh: 我明白了。那再利用呢？

sentences.t: Reusing means making *use*‿of something *again* or in another way, such‿as using the water from your showers to clean the toilet and donating old clothes to *charity*.
sentences.zh: 再利用是指把东西再次使用或换一种方式使用，比如用洗澡水冲厕所，把旧衣服捐给慈善机构。

sentences.t: How do we *recycle*?
sentences.zh: 我们怎样回收呢？

sentences.t: When we recycle, we turn *used* materials‿into *new* products.
sentences.zh: 回收就是把用过的材料变成新产品。

sentences.t: We can recycle many things‿in our *daily* life, such‿as *paper* boxes, *glass* bottles and so on.
sentences.zh: 日常生活中我们可以回收很多东西，比如纸箱、玻璃瓶等等。

sentences.t: Thanks! I guess we *all* should *follow* the three Rs‿in our *life*.
sentences.zh: 谢谢！我想我们在生活中都应该遵循“3R”原则。

sentences.t: There you *go*.
sentences.zh: 说得对。

sentences.t: You have *got* my *message*!
sentences.zh: 你已经明白我的意思了！

sentences.t: What do you *usually* do to be a *greener* *person*?
sentences.zh: 你平时做些什么来让自己更环保？
sentences.tip: 书中重读：What, usually, do, greener, person

sentences.t: Well, I always *turn*‿off the *lights* when I leave *home*.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我离开家时总是关灯。
sentences.tip: turn off 连读；书中重读：turn, off, lights, leave, home

sentences.t: Great. What‿about you, *Xiao Ya*?
sentences.zh: 很好。你呢，小雅？
sentences.tip: What about 连读；重读 Great, What, Xiao Ya

sentences.t: I always *ride* my *bike* to *school*.
sentences.zh: 我总是骑自行车上学。
sentences.tip: 书中重读：always, ride, bike, school

sentences.t: This can help *save*‿energy and *reduce* *pollution*.
sentences.zh: 这样可以帮助节约能源、减少污染。
sentences.tip: save energy 连读；书中重读：help, save, energy, reduce, pollution

sentences.t: *We're* Going *Green*
sentences.zh: 我们要走绿色环保之路

sentences.t: We're going to take *care*‿of the *Earth*.
sentences.zh: 我们要爱护地球。
sentences.tip: care of 连读；take, care, Earth 重读，of, the 弱读

sentences.t: We can go *green*‿at *home*‿or *school*.
sentences.zh: 我们可以在家里或学校践行环保。

sentences.t: Reducing: Turn‿off the *water* when we're *brushing* our *teeth*.
sentences.zh: 减量：刷牙时关掉水龙头。

sentences.t: Pull‿out *plugs* when they are not‿in *use*.
sentences.zh: 电器不用时拔掉插头。

sentences.t: And don't *forget* to pick‿up *trash*.
sentences.zh: 还有，别忘了捡起垃圾。

sentences.t: Reusing: If we can use the *stuff*‿again, don't *throw* it‿out.
sentences.zh: 再利用：如果东西还能再用，就别扔掉。

sentences.t: We can reuse *bottles*, *bags*, and *containers*.
sentences.zh: 我们可以重复使用瓶子、袋子和容器。

sentences.t: Donate‿old *toys*‿and *clothes*, so someone‿else can *use* them.
sentences.zh: 把旧玩具和旧衣服捐出去，让别人还能用上。

sentences.t: Recycling: *Just* reusing some things‿is *not*‿enough.
sentences.zh: 回收：仅仅重复使用一些东西是不够的。

sentences.t: *Recycle* them to make *new* *stuff*, like paper, cans, metals‿and plastic.
sentences.zh: 要回收它们，制成新东西，比如纸、罐子、金属和塑料。

sentences.t: Noises‿are *unpleasant* sounds.
sentences.zh: 噪音是令人不愉快的声音。

sentences.t: *Cars*, machines, loudspeakers‿and many other things can *produce* *noises*.
sentences.zh: 汽车、机器、扬声器等许多东西都会产生噪音。

sentences.t: Long-lasting‿or sudden loud noises can do *great* *harm* to people's *hearing* and cause hearing problems.
sentences.zh: 持续的或突然的巨大噪音会严重损害人的听力，导致听力问题。

sentences.t: Serious hearing problems can have further *negative* effects‿on people's *health* and cause‿*other* health problems, like high blood pressure, heart disease and so on.
sentences.zh: 严重的听力问题会进一步危害人们的健康，引发其他健康问题，比如高血压、心脏病等。

sentences.t: Shanghai started waste *sorting*‿in *2019*, and soon‿*other* cities followed.
sentences.zh: 上海于2019年开始实行垃圾分类，不久其他城市也纷纷跟进。

sentences.t: Waste sorting‿is very *important* for *environmental* protection.
sentences.zh: 垃圾分类对环境保护非常重要。

sentences.t: To sort the wastes, we put them‿into *bins*‿of *different* *colors*.
sentences.zh: 为了给垃圾分类，我们把垃圾放进不同颜色的垃圾桶里。

sentences.t: The *blue* bin‿is used for recycling paper‿and plastics, the *green* one‿is for kitchen waste, the *red* one is for the harmful or dangerous waste and the gray one is for others.
sentences.zh: 蓝色桶用于回收纸张和塑料，绿色桶装厨余垃圾，红色桶装有害或危险垃圾，灰色桶装其他垃圾。

sentences.t: Sorting the waste‿is *not* *easy*.
sentences.zh: 垃圾分类并不容易。

sentences.t: So, besides *colors*, there‿are also *signs*‿and *texts* on each bin to help people sort waste correctly.
sentences.zh: 所以，除了颜色之外，每个垃圾桶上还有标志和文字，帮助人们正确分类。

sentences.t: Communities often hold different *activities* to *teach* people how to sort the waste, and sometimes you can see *volunteers* help people put the waste‿into the right bin.
sentences.zh: 社区经常举办各种活动教人们如何分类垃圾，有时还能看到志愿者帮人们把垃圾投进正确的桶里。

sentences.t: In northwest China's Shaanxi Province, a *farmer* has fought‿against *desert* growth for more than *40* years.
sentences.zh: 在中国西北部的陕西省，一位农民与沙漠扩张抗争了40多年。

sentences.t: His name‿is *Shi Guangyin*.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫石光银。

sentences.t: The *spreading*‿of *deserts* has been‿an environmental *problem* around the world.
sentences.zh: 沙漠扩张一直是一个世界性的环境问题。

sentences.t: In the 1980s, the Chinese government began to *encourage* people to *plant* trees‿in the *northern* part‿of China.
sentences.zh: 20世纪80年代，中国政府开始鼓励人们在中国北方植树。

sentences.t: Shi Guangyin *took* the *chance*‿in *1984*.
sentences.zh: 1984年，石光银抓住了这个机会。

sentences.t: He *cooperated* with some‿other villagers to *plant* trees‿in the *desert* and started his fighting‿against desert growth ever since then.
sentences.zh: 他和其他一些村民合作在沙漠里植树，从那时起便开始了与沙漠扩张的斗争。

sentences.t: In the *first* year, many trees *survived*, and the land became‿a little *greener*.
sentences.zh: 第一年，许多树活了下来，土地变绿了一些。

sentences.t: Yet, after‿only a few years, *sandstorms* killed *most*‿of the *young* trees.
sentences.zh: 然而，仅仅几年之后，沙尘暴就毁掉了大部分幼树。

sentences.t: However, Shi *didn't* give‿*up*.
sentences.zh: 但是，石光银没有放弃。

sentences.t: He asked‿*experts* for *advice* and tried to learn from *successful* experience‿around the world.
sentences.zh: 他向专家请教，并努力学习世界各地的成功经验。

sentences.t: Soon, he started *all* over‿*again*.
sentences.zh: 很快，他又从头开始了。

sentences.t: He *founded*‿a *sand-control* company and led people to set‿up *blocks* to protect the trees from sandstorms.
sentences.zh: 他创办了一家治沙公司，带领人们设置沙障，保护树木免受沙尘暴侵袭。

sentences.t: A lot *more* trees *survived* this time, and the villagers could‿also make some *money* while fighting to control sands with Shi's company.
sentences.zh: 这一次，活下来的树多了很多，村民们在跟着石光银的公司治沙的同时还能赚些钱。

sentences.t: In 2021, Shi Guangyin *received* the *July 1 Medal*‿in *honor*‿of his efforts to control the desert growth.
sentences.zh: 2021年，石光银被授予“七一勋章”，以表彰他在治理沙漠扩张方面所作的努力。

sentences.t: However, Shi *didn't* *rest*‿on this *honor*.
sentences.zh: 然而，石光银并没有躺在功劳簿上。

sentences.t: "We need to *continue* our *efforts*, year‿after year, to *protect* the environment." said Shi‿in‿an interview.
sentences.zh: “我们需要年复一年地继续努力，保护环境。”石光银在一次采访中说。

sentences.t: It's a good *idea* to *reuse* plastic bags‿as *waste* bags.
sentences.zh: 把塑料袋重复用作垃圾袋是个好主意。

sentences.t: Scientists have *found*‿a *new* way to *recycle* waste paper‿into new paper products.
sentences.zh: 科学家们找到了一种把废纸回收制成新纸制品的新方法。

sentences.t: Our *community* has *renewed* calls for *cleaning*‿up the waste‿along the river.
sentences.zh: 我们社区再次呼吁清理河边的垃圾。

sentences.t: Hi, Kangkang! Did you take *part*‿in the *speech*‿about *waste* sorting last Saturday?
sentences.zh: 嗨，康康！你参加上周六关于垃圾分类的讲座了吗？

sentences.t: Yes, I *did*.
sentences.zh: 是的，我参加了。

sentences.t: I have *learned*‿a *lot*‿about *sorting* the waste since I listened to the speech.
sentences.zh: 自从听了那次讲座，我学到了很多关于垃圾分类的知识。

sentences.t: Me *too*. I have *kept* sorting‿out *all* the waste‿at home for five days.
sentences.zh: 我也是。我已经坚持在家给所有垃圾分类五天了。

sentences.t: Now I am *really* *good*‿at it.
sentences.zh: 现在我真的很擅长分类了。

sentences.t: Hi, I'm *Xiao Ya*.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是小雅。

sentences.t: I always write‿on *both* sides‿of the paper, and I also like to *reuse* paper boxes, plastic cups‿and many other *things*.
sentences.zh: 我总是在纸的两面写字，还喜欢重复利用纸箱、塑料杯等许多东西。

sentences.t: In fact, I've *long* been used to thinking *twice* before *throwing* things‿away.
sentences.zh: 其实，我早就习惯了扔东西之前三思。

sentences.t: Hi, my name‿is *Li Ming*.
sentences.zh: 你好，我叫李明。

sentences.t: I've been‿a *member*‿of our school's *green* club for *2* years.
sentences.zh: 我加入学校的环保社团已经两年了。

sentences.t: One‿of the most *important* activities‿of our club‿is to *plant* trees on *March 12*, our National Tree-planting Day.
sentences.zh: 我们社团最重要的活动之一就是在3月12日——我国的植树节植树。

sentences.t: We've planted *many* trees now, and we take *very* good *care*‿of the trees‿all the year round.
sentences.zh: 现在我们已经种了很多树，而且一年到头都精心照料它们。

sentences.t: Hi, I'm *Kangkang*.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是康康。

sentences.t: I *ride* my *bike*‿or take the *bus* to and from school.
sentences.zh: 我骑自行车或坐公交车上下学。

sentences.t: When I go out, I also take the *underground*‿as *much*‿as *possible*.
sentences.zh: 外出时，我也尽可能乘坐地铁。

sentences.t: I think, by doing so, we're doing our *part*‿of going *green*.
sentences.zh: 我认为，这样做就是在为绿色环保尽我们的一份力。

sentences.t: My name‿is *Li Xiang*.
sentences.zh: 我叫李想。

sentences.t: We have‿all learned‿a *lot* about *air* pollution since Mr. Wang's *geography* lesson last week.
sentences.zh: 自从上周王老师的地理课以来，我们都学到了很多关于空气污染的知识。

sentences.t: But *today*, let's talk‿about *water* pollution.
sentences.zh: 不过今天，我们来谈谈水污染。

sentences.t: First‿of‿all, people have put lots of *unclean* things‿into rivers and lakes, such as *waste* water and *rubbish*.
sentences.zh: 首先，人们把许多脏东西倒进河流和湖泊，比如废水和垃圾。

sentences.t: Such‿actions have *reduced* the *quality* of our *drinking* water.
sentences.zh: 这些行为降低了我们饮用水的质量。

sentences.t: Besides, *farm*‿and *factory* activities have‿also been the *main* causes‿of water pollution.
sentences.zh: 此外，农业和工厂活动也是水污染的主要原因。

sentences.t: For many years, farms‿and factories have poured *harmful* materials‿and *waste*‿into *rivers*.
sentences.zh: 多年来，农场和工厂一直把有害物质和废物排入河流。

sentences.t: As‿a result, the *natural* environment has *suffered* *greatly*.
sentences.zh: 结果，自然环境受到了极大的破坏。

sentences.t: Worse yet, *oil* pollution from ships‿and *land-based* factories‿is also *serious*.
sentences.zh: 更糟糕的是，来自船只和陆上工厂的石油污染也很严重。

sentences.t: It has *polluted* the *ocean*‿and *harmed* plants‿and animals‿as well.
sentences.zh: 它污染了海洋，也危害了动植物。

sentences.t: In‿a word, water pollution has become‿a *great* danger to *human* health and the *environment*.
sentences.zh: 总之，水污染已经对人类健康和环境构成了巨大的危害。

sentences.t: We need to *reconsider*‿our way of *living* and *protect* our home planet.
sentences.zh: 我们需要重新思考自己的生活方式，保护我们的地球家园。

sentences.t: *Everyone* can be a *green* person‿at *any* time‿and place.
sentences.zh: 每个人都可以随时随地成为一个环保的人。

sentences.t: Today, I'd like to *share* my ideas‿on how to be a *greener* person‿in the *kitchen*.
sentences.zh: 今天，我想分享一下如何在厨房里做到更环保。

sentences.t: First‿of‿all, *reduce* food *waste*.
sentences.zh: 首先，减少食物浪费。

sentences.t: Don't prepare *more* food than you can‿*eat*, so you need to *plan* your meals carefully.
sentences.zh: 不要准备超出你能吃完的食物，所以你需要仔细计划你的饭菜。

sentences.t: Also, making‿a *shopping* list‿is *helpful*.
sentences.zh: 另外，列一张购物清单也很有帮助。

sentences.t: It can *keep* you from buying *more* things than you *really* need.
sentences.zh: 它可以避免你买超过实际需要的东西。

sentences.t: Secondly, say *no* to *plastics*.
sentences.zh: 第二，拒绝塑料制品。

sentences.t: Don't use *plastic* cups‿or *bags*.
sentences.zh: 不要使用塑料杯或塑料袋。

sentences.t: We can use *glass* cups more‿often and *cloth* bags for *shopping*.
sentences.zh: 我们可以多用玻璃杯，购物时用布袋。

sentences.t: This can *greatly* help *reduce* *kitchen* waste.
sentences.zh: 这能大大减少厨房垃圾。

sentences.t: Also, try *not* to buy things with *plastic* *packaging*.
sentences.zh: 另外，尽量不要买带塑料包装的东西。

sentences.t: Thirdly, try to *save*‿*energy*.
sentences.zh: 第三，努力节约能源。

sentences.t: Yes, you *can* save‿energy *right* from your *kitchen*.
sentences.zh: 没错，你就可以从自家厨房开始节约能源。

sentences.t: For‿example, you *don't* have to use the *oven* so *often*.
sentences.zh: 例如，你不必那么频繁地使用烤箱。

sentences.t: If you *do* need to use the oven, you may think‿of cooking more than *one* thing‿at a time, so as to *save* energy.
sentences.zh: 如果确实需要用烤箱，你可以考虑一次烤不止一样东西，以便节约能源。

sentences.t: Earth‿is our *only* home, but we are *not* taking good *care*‿of‿it.
sentences.zh: 地球是我们唯一的家园，但我们没有好好爱护它。

sentences.t: Many factories‿are polluting the *air*‿and *water*, and many farmers are polluting the *soil* when they use harmful things to kill the insects.
sentences.zh: 许多工厂在污染空气和水，许多农民用有害物质杀虫时也在污染土壤。

sentences.t: Other pollutions‿are‿also becoming *more*‿and more *serious*.
sentences.zh: 其他污染也变得越来越严重。

sentences.t: Earth‿is *crying* for *help*!
sentences.zh: 地球正在呼救！

sentences.t: What can we do to *save*‿our home *Earth*?
sentences.zh: 我们能做些什么来拯救我们的地球家园呢？

sentences.t: Most‿importantly, we should do *everything* *possible* to *prevent* pollution.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，我们应该尽一切可能防止污染。

sentences.t: For‿example, factories should use *modern* technology to *stop* producing pollution, or the government should *punish* them.
sentences.zh: 例如，工厂应该使用现代技术停止制造污染，否则政府应该惩罚它们。

sentences.t: We should then try our *best* to *reduce* pollution.
sentences.zh: 然后我们应该尽最大努力减少污染。

sentences.t: As we all know, *small*‿acts can make‿a *big* difference, and we can make it happen if we act‿as *one*.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，小小的行动可以带来大大的改变，只要我们齐心协力，就能做到。

sentences.t: Also, don't *forget* to plant more trees, because trees‿are the *lungs*‿of Earth and can help *clean* the air.
sentences.zh: 另外，别忘了多种树，因为树是地球的肺，能帮助净化空气。

sentences.t: There is *always* more to do, and we also need to make *greater* efforts to *save* Earth.
sentences.zh: 要做的事总是还有很多，我们还需要付出更大的努力来拯救地球。

sentences.t: After‿all, we have *only* *one* home planet‿in the *universe*.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，在宇宙中我们只有一个地球家园。

sentences.t: What do you *think* the Great *Britain* is *famous* for?
sentences.zh: 你认为英国以什么而闻名？

sentences.t: *Big* *Ben*.
sentences.zh: 大本钟。

sentences.t: It *weighs* more than *15* tons.
sentences.zh: 它重达15吨以上。

sentences.t: Do you know what the *official language* of the Great *Britain*‿is?
sentences.zh: 你知道英国的官方语言是什么吗？

sentences.t: Yes, it's‿*English*.
sentences.zh: 是的，是英语。

sentences.t: *Learning*‿a foreign language can *benefit*‿us in many *ways*.
sentences.zh: 学习外语能在很多方面让我们受益。

sentences.t: First, it‿allows you to *experience* new *cultures*, and you may also find‿it *enjoyable* to talk with people from different cultures.
sentences.zh: 第一，它能让你体验新的文化，而且你也许会发现和来自不同文化的人交谈很愉快。

sentences.t: Second, it gives you a better *chance* of *winning*‿in the *job* market.
sentences.zh: 第二，它让你在就业市场上有更大的机会胜出。

sentences.t: The world is‿a big *village* now.
sentences.zh: 如今世界是一个大村庄。

sentences.t: If you speak‿a *foreign language*, your chance of getting‿a good *job* will be greatly *improved*.
sentences.zh: 如果你会说一门外语，你找到好工作的机会将大大增加。

sentences.t: Third, learning to use‿a new language is‿an *excellent training* of the *brain*.
sentences.zh: 第三，学习使用一门新语言是对大脑极好的训练。

sentences.t: The brain needs to work *actively* when you *either* try to *understand*‿or speak the language.
sentences.zh: 无论你是尝试理解还是说这门语言，大脑都需要积极地运转。

sentences.t: In‿a word, by learning‿a foreign language, a whole *new world* will be *opened*‿up for you.
sentences.zh: 总之，通过学习一门外语，一个全新的世界将向你敞开。

sentences.t: Hi, *Kangkang*, *Yukio*!
sentences.zh: 嗨，康康，由纪夫！

sentences.t: Hello, *Jane*!
sentences.zh: 你好，简！

sentences.t: Yukio, when Jane says "Hi", she *waves* her hand, but when you say "Hello", you *bow*.
sentences.zh: 由纪夫，简说“嗨”的时候会挥手，而你说“你好”的时候会鞠躬。

sentences.t: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.t: In *Japan*, we *bow* when we *meet*.
sentences.zh: 在日本，我们见面时会鞠躬。

sentences.t: We also *bow* to say "thank you", "goodbye", "sorry" or to‿ask for *help*.
sentences.zh: 我们说“谢谢”“再见”“对不起”或者请求帮助时也会鞠躬。

sentences.t: That's‿*interesting*.
sentences.zh: 真有意思。

sentences.t: In *Canada*, we *wave* to say "hello" or "goodbye".
sentences.zh: 在加拿大，我们挥手表示“你好”或“再见”。

sentences.t: It's the *same*‿in *China*.
sentences.zh: 在中国也一样。

sentences.t: Kangkang, just now you *nodded* your head to show your *agreement*.
sentences.zh: 康康，你刚才点头表示同意。

sentences.t: But‿in *India*, it‿is quite the *opposite*.
sentences.zh: 但在印度，情况恰恰相反。

sentences.t: While *nodding* means "no", *shaking* the head from side to side means "yes".
sentences.zh: 点头表示“不”，而左右摇头表示“是”。

sentences.t: How *interesting*!
sentences.zh: 多有趣啊！

sentences.t: So the *same* body language can mean *different* things‿in different *cultures*.
sentences.zh: 所以同样的肢体语言在不同文化中可能意思不同。

sentences.t: Yeah!
sentences.zh: 是啊！

sentences.t: And‿in most countries, it‿is *bad manners* to use your finger‿or hand to wave someone to *come* to you.
sentences.zh: 而且在大多数国家，用手指或手招呼别人过来是不礼貌的。

sentences.t: Do you know *this*?
sentences.zh: 你知道这一点吗？

sentences.t: Is that *so*?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.t: We must be *careful* when we use body language to *communicate* with people from different *countries*.
sentences.zh: 我们用肢体语言和来自不同国家的人交流时一定要小心。

sentences.t: I *agree*!
sentences.zh: 我同意！

sentences.t: I'm *not* good‿at *German*.
sentences.zh: 我不擅长德语。
sentences.tip: 课本重读标记：not, good, German；good at 连读

sentences.t: *English* is *widely spoken* all over the *world*.
sentences.zh: 英语在全世界被广泛使用。
sentences.tip: 课本重读：English, widely, spoken, world；在 spoken 后稍作停顿

sentences.t: *Body language* is *important* to *communicate* with people.
sentences.zh: 肢体语言对与人交流很重要。
sentences.tip: 课本重读：Body, language, important, communicate, people；在 important 后停顿

sentences.t: *Try* your best‿and *work hard* to practice *Chinese* from now on.
sentences.zh: 从现在起尽你最大努力，刻苦练习汉语。
sentences.tip: 停顿：Try your best / and work hard / to practice Chinese / from now on

sentences.t: What do you *plan* to do in the *winter holiday*?
sentences.zh: 寒假你打算做什么？
sentences.tip: 特殊疑问句用降调

sentences.t: My *parents* and‿I are going to *visit* Los *Angeles*.
sentences.zh: 我和父母打算去洛杉矶。

sentences.t: Wow, good *idea*!
sentences.zh: 哇，好主意！

sentences.t: There‿is‿a *Disneyland* nearby.
sentences.zh: 那附近有个迪士尼乐园。

sentences.t: Will you go *there*?
sentences.zh: 你会去那儿吗？
sentences.tip: 一般疑问句用升调

sentences.t: Yes, of *course*.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然。

sentences.t: I *like* the *cartoon characters* very much.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢那些卡通人物。

sentences.t: Do you *expect* the *trip*?
sentences.zh: 你期待这次旅行吗？
sentences.tip: 一般疑问句用升调

sentences.t: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.t: I really *can't wait* to *fly* there.
sentences.zh: 我真迫不及待想飞过去。

sentences.t: You'll have‿a good *chance* to *practice*‿*English* there.
sentences.zh: 你在那儿会有很好的机会练习英语。

sentences.t: You're *right*.
sentences.zh: 你说得对。

sentences.t: *English* is spoken‿as the *official* language‿in *America*.
sentences.zh: 在美国，英语作为官方语言被使用。

sentences.t: *Wish* you have‿a *good time* there.
sentences.zh: 祝你在那儿玩得开心。

sentences.t: *Thank* you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.t: What does the *picture*‿on the *left* say?
sentences.zh: 左边的图说的是什么？

sentences.t: It tells‿a *story* in *American Sign Language* (ASL): An‿apple is sitting‿on a desk, waiting for a cat to eat.
sentences.zh: 它用美国手语讲了一个故事：一个苹果放在桌子上，等着一只猫来吃。

sentences.t: This is how *deaf* children learn to *sign* the *letters*‿in ASL.
sentences.zh: 这就是聋哑儿童学习用美国手语比画字母的方法。

sentences.t: A is like‿an *apple*, B is like‿a *desk* and C is like‿a *cat*.
sentences.zh: A像一个苹果，B像一张桌子，C像一只猫。

sentences.t: People with *hearing problems* can use *sign language* for *communication*.
sentences.zh: 有听力障碍的人可以用手语交流。

sentences.t: They *spell*‿out the *letters* one by one by using their *fingers*.
sentences.zh: 他们用手指把字母一个一个地拼出来。

sentences.t: This‿is called "*fingerspelling*".
sentences.zh: 这叫作“指拼法”。

sentences.t: They also use different *expressions*‿on their *faces* to say "hello", "goodbye", "please", "thank you", "yes" or "no", etc.
sentences.zh: 他们还用不同的面部表情来表达“你好”“再见”“请”“谢谢”“是”或“不”等。

sentences.t: The *expressions* on the *face* and the *body language* are important in sign language.
sentences.zh: 面部表情和肢体语言在手语中很重要。

sentences.t: There‿are many *different* sign languages‿in the world because of the different *cultures*.
sentences.zh: 由于文化不同，世界上有许多不同的手语。

sentences.t: Meimei is *singing*‿an *English song*.
sentences.zh: 梅梅正在唱一首英文歌。

sentences.t: She is *reading* the *lyrics* while singing.
sentences.zh: 她一边唱一边看着歌词。

sentences.t: Do you know that‿if you *imitate* how someone talks, you'll *understand* what they say *better*?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？如果你模仿别人说话的方式，你会更好地理解他们说的话。

sentences.t: *Imitating* is‿a very *useful skill*.
sentences.zh: 模仿是一项非常有用的技能。

sentences.t: It can help you better *comprehend* the *speech*.
sentences.zh: 它能帮助你更好地理解讲话内容。

sentences.t: To learn‿a new language, it's *best* to *copy* the *native speakers*.
sentences.zh: 学习一门新语言，最好是模仿以这种语言为母语的人。

sentences.t: And‿if you want to learn the language *faster*, don't just *copy* how your partner *talks*.
sentences.zh: 而且如果你想学得更快，不要只模仿同伴说话的方式。

sentences.t: Try to use this *imitation method* and *copy* their *body languages*‿as well.
sentences.zh: 试着用这种模仿法，把他们的肢体语言也模仿下来。

sentences.t: In this way, you'll *sound* like‿a *native* very soon.
sentences.zh: 这样，你很快就会听起来像个本族语者。

sentences.t: Hello, *ladies*‿and *gentlemen*!
sentences.zh: 女士们，先生们，大家好！

sentences.t: *Welcome* to the *United Nations*.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到联合国。

sentences.t: I'm your *tour guide*, *Amy*!
sentences.zh: 我是你们的导游艾米！

sentences.t: There‿are *six official languages*‿at the UN.
sentences.zh: 联合国有六种官方语言。

sentences.t: Now, let me *walk* you through these *amazing* languages.
sentences.zh: 现在，让我带大家了解一下这些神奇的语言。

sentences.t: First, let's talk‿about *Arabic*.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们来谈谈阿拉伯语。

sentences.t: It‿is the *official* language of‿over *20* countries across *North Africa* and the Middle East.
sentences.zh: 它是北非和中东地区20多个国家的官方语言。

sentences.t: *Arabic* is becoming‿one of the most *important* languages.
sentences.zh: 阿拉伯语正在成为最重要的语言之一。

sentences.t: Next, there‿is *Chinese*.
sentences.zh: 接下来是汉语。

sentences.t: There‿are more than *1.4 billion* Chinese *speakers*.
sentences.zh: 说汉语的人超过14亿。

sentences.t: With the *rapid development* of China, Chinese will be *spoken*‿and learned by more‿and more people outside China.
sentences.zh: 随着中国的快速发展，中国以外将会有越来越多的人说汉语、学汉语。

sentences.t: *English* is the most *widely used* language.
sentences.zh: 英语是使用最广泛的语言。

sentences.t: There are *less* than *400 million* native English speakers.
sentences.zh: 以英语为母语的人不到4亿。

sentences.t: Around the world, *important articles*‿and *books* are published‿in English.
sentences.zh: 在全世界，重要的文章和书籍都用英语出版。

sentences.t: Besides English, *French* is‿also an *important* language‿in learning Western *culture*.
sentences.zh: 除了英语，法语也是学习西方文化的一门重要语言。

sentences.t: Outside‿of *France*, French is used‿in about *30* countries in Africa, Europe and North America.
sentences.zh: 在法国以外，非洲、欧洲和北美约有30个国家使用法语。

sentences.t: *Russian* is spoken by around *150 million* people‿as their *mother tongue*.
sentences.zh: 约有1.5亿人以俄语为母语。

sentences.t: Russia is‿a *global leader* in several *industries*.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯在好几个行业中处于全球领先地位。

sentences.t: Speaking Russian can‿also be *useful*‿in looking for *jobs*.
sentences.zh: 会说俄语在找工作时也很有用。

sentences.t: Last but not *least*, I'd like to introduce *Spanish*.
sentences.zh: 最后但同样重要的是，我想介绍一下西班牙语。

sentences.t: *Believe*‿it‿or not, there are *more* native speakers of *Spanish* than those‿of English.
sentences.zh: 信不信由你，以西班牙语为母语的人比以英语为母语的人还多。

sentences.t: Take the United States for‿example, Spanish is now the most *popular second language*.
sentences.zh: 以美国为例，西班牙语现在是最受欢迎的第二语言。

sentences.t: Well, that's‿it!
sentences.zh: 好了，就这些！

sentences.t: Now, any *questions*?
sentences.zh: 现在，大家有什么问题吗？

sentences.t: Sue spent‿an *enjoyable* afternoon with her friends learning *Chinese*.
sentences.zh: 休和朋友们一起学汉语，度过了一个愉快的下午。

sentences.t: The students‿are *teachable* and‿*eager* to learn knowledge.
sentences.zh: 这些学生很好教，而且渴望学习知识。

sentences.t: *Look*!
sentences.zh: 看！

sentences.t: How *carefully* they are *listening*!
sentences.zh: 他们听得多认真啊！

sentences.t: This *5-year-old* girl can speak more than *8* languages.
sentences.zh: 这个5岁的女孩能说8种以上的语言。

sentences.t: It's really *unbelievable*.
sentences.zh: 这真令人难以置信。

sentences.t: There are *all kinds* of language learning *tools*‿on the internet now.
sentences.zh: 现在网上有各种各样的语言学习工具。

sentences.t: Most‿of them *won't cost* you a *cent*.
sentences.zh: 其中大多数一分钱都不用花。

sentences.t: You can *download* them to your computer‿or phone, or you can use them *online*.
sentences.zh: 你可以把它们下载到电脑或手机上，也可以在线使用。

sentences.t: If you often use these tools to help your study, you may find that you can *actually avoid* many *mistakes*, and your learning skills will‿also be greatly *improved*.
sentences.zh: 如果你经常用这些工具辅助学习，你可能会发现自己确实能避免很多错误，学习能力也会大大提高。

sentences.t: I hear that *Chinese* will be *taught*‿as‿a *second language* in more Russian schools.
sentences.zh: 我听说更多的俄罗斯学校将把汉语作为第二语言来教授。

sentences.t: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.t: It was *reported*‿on *TV* last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚电视上报道了。

sentences.t: Chinese will be *learned* by *more people* then.
sentences.zh: 那样的话，将会有更多的人学汉语。

sentences.t: In the *future*, when we travel‿around the world and speak *Chinese*, we will be *understood*.
sentences.zh: 将来我们周游世界说汉语时，别人就能听懂了。

sentences.t: It sounds *wonderful*.
sentences.zh: 听起来太棒了。

sentences.t: *Preparations* will be *made*‿a *month* before the contest.
sentences.zh: 准备工作将在比赛前一个月进行。

sentences.t: I'm *Bill*.
sentences.zh: 我是比尔。

sentences.t: I'm now *studying Chinese*‿in a Chinese *university*.
sentences.zh: 我现在在一所中国大学学习汉语。

sentences.t: Learning Chinese is *not easy*, but‿it's *fun* to speak Chinese with the *locals*.
sentences.zh: 学汉语不容易，但和当地人说汉语很有趣。

sentences.t: I like *singing* Chinese songs and *watching* Chinese *movies*.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢唱中文歌、看中国电影。

sentences.t: You can find some‿of the *lines* are written *really well* and‿it's quite *enjoyable* to learn to say them.
sentences.zh: 你会发现有些台词写得非常好，学着说这些台词很有乐趣。

sentences.t: Also, the Chinese *culture* is *best seen*‿in the songs‿and movies.
sentences.zh: 而且，中国文化在歌曲和电影中体现得最充分。

sentences.t: I'm *Sophia*.
sentences.zh: 我是索菲娅。

sentences.t: I have been to *China* many *times*.
sentences.zh: 我去过中国很多次。

sentences.t: I am very *interested*‿in Chinese *culture* and have taken lots‿of *pictures* of different cultural sites.
sentences.zh: 我对中国文化很感兴趣，拍了很多不同文化景点的照片。

sentences.t: To know more‿about *China*, I started *learning Chinese* a few years‿ago.
sentences.zh: 为了更多地了解中国，我几年前开始学汉语。

sentences.t: It‿is *really difficult*, so I'm taking *lessons* from a Chinese *student* now.
sentences.zh: 汉语真的很难，所以我现在跟一位中国学生上课。

sentences.t: I believe, with the *rapid development* of China, Chinese language‿and culture will be *widely spread* across the world.
sentences.zh: 我相信，随着中国的快速发展，汉语和中国文化将在全世界广泛传播。

sentences.t: Learning another language is not only learning *different words* for the *same things*, but learning *another way* to think about things.
sentences.zh: 学习另一种语言不仅是学习同一事物的不同说法，更是学习另一种思考事物的方式。
sentences.tip: 弗洛拉·刘易斯名言；not only ... but ... 前后两部分可稍作停顿

sentences.t: My name is *Michael*.
sentences.zh: 我叫迈克尔。

sentences.t: I'm in *Grade 8* in‿a *public school* of New York City.
sentences.zh: 我在纽约市的一所公立学校上八年级。

sentences.t: I have been learning *Chinese* for *three years*.
sentences.zh: 我学汉语已经三年了。

sentences.t: Many people‿ask me *why* I want to learn Chinese.
sentences.zh: 很多人问我为什么想学汉语。

sentences.t: When I *really think*‿about‿it, there are *so many reasons*.
sentences.zh: 当我认真想一想，原因有很多。

sentences.t: Since I was‿a little kid, I have *always* been *interested*‿in Chinese *culture*.
sentences.zh: 我从小就一直对中国文化感兴趣。

sentences.t: My home was only *10 minutes*‿away from *Chinatown*.
sentences.zh: 我家离唐人街只有10分钟的路程。

sentences.t: I *loved* going to Chinese *restaurants* with my family and watching *dragon dances* during the Spring Festival.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢和家人去中餐馆，春节期间看舞龙。

sentences.t: In the 6th grade, my primary school *offered*‿a *world language course*.
sentences.zh: 六年级时，我的小学开设了一门世界语言课程。

sentences.t: Most‿of my classmates went for *Spanish*‿or *French*, but‿I found writing Chinese characters and understanding Chinese grammar *challenging* and *enjoyable*.
sentences.zh: 我的大多数同学选了西班牙语或法语，但我觉得写汉字、理解汉语语法既有挑战性又有乐趣。

sentences.t: After learning Chinese for some time, I started to *dream* of *traveling* to *China* one day.
sentences.zh: 学了一段时间汉语后，我开始梦想有一天去中国旅行。

sentences.t: My *father* went to China‿on *business* once.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸曾经去中国出过差。

sentences.t: He told me that China has one‿of the world's *oldest cultures* and has become one‿of the *largest economies*.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，中国拥有世界上最古老的文化之一，并已成为最大的经济体之一。

sentences.t: Learning Chinese can *surely* allow me to better *experience* China's *traditional culture* and modern development‿as well.
sentences.zh: 学汉语一定能让我更好地体验中国的传统文化以及现代发展。

sentences.t: In‿any case, Chinese will be *more widely used* in the future‿as China is growing *stronger*.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，随着中国日益强大，汉语将来会被更广泛地使用。

sentences.t: Why not *join* me‿and study this *interesting*‿and *valuable* language?
sentences.zh: 为什么不和我一起学习这门有趣又有价值的语言呢？

sentences.t: Hi, *Lingling*.
sentences.zh: 嗨，玲玲。

sentences.t: Why are you reading so *loudly*?
sentences.zh: 你为什么读得这么大声？

sentences.t: Oh, I'm *sorry*, but‿I find reading *aloud* can help me *remember* better.
sentences.zh: 哦，对不起，不过我发现大声朗读能帮我记得更牢。

sentences.t: That's *no trouble* to me.
sentences.zh: 这对我没什么妨碍。

sentences.t: I also read that‿it's *advisable* to read *aloud* in *foreign language* learning.
sentences.zh: 我也读到过，在外语学习中大声朗读是明智的做法。

sentences.t: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.t: I remember Mr. *Zhao Yuanren* once said so *too*.
sentences.zh: 我记得赵元任先生也曾这么说过。

sentences.t: Zhao was *famous*‿in language learning, and he taught *Chinese*‿in an *American university*.
sentences.zh: 赵元任在语言学习方面很有名，他曾在一所美国大学教汉语。

sentences.t: I've heard‿about him *too*.
sentences.zh: 我也听说过他。

sentences.t: He could speak *English*, French and German, and read *Greek*‿and *Latin*.
sentences.zh: 他会说英语、法语和德语，还能读希腊语和拉丁语。

sentences.t: That's *true*.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.t: He also used his *own* language learning *method*‿in his teaching, and his teaching method has *influenced* many people around the world.
sentences.zh: 他还在教学中运用了自己的语言学习方法，他的教学方法影响了全世界许多人。

sentences.t: Are you *following* his *suggestion* to read *aloud*?
sentences.zh: 你是在按照他的建议大声朗读吗？

sentences.t: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.t: According to Zhao, we should *focus*‿on the *spoken language* first‿and read‿aloud as *much* as possible.
sentences.zh: 赵元任认为，我们应该先注重口语，并尽可能多地大声朗读。

sentences.t: *Great*.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.t: I hope his *method* will be used *more widely* and help more people to learn foreign languages.
sentences.zh: 我希望他的方法能被更广泛地使用，帮助更多人学习外语。

sentences.t: English is *widely spoken* all‿over the *world* and used‿as‿a *medium* to communicate.
sentences.zh: 英语在全世界被广泛使用，并被用作交流的媒介。

sentences.t: It has *changed*‿in many ways over the *centuries*, and is still *changing* to meet people's need to communicate across cultures.
sentences.zh: 几个世纪以来它在许多方面发生了变化，而且仍在变化，以满足人们跨文化交流的需要。

sentences.t: In the past, English was the *official language* of *England*.
sentences.zh: 过去，英语是英格兰的官方语言。

sentences.t: It then became the official language of *many other countries* as more people started to *speak*‿it.
sentences.zh: 后来，随着越来越多的人开始说英语，它成为许多其他国家的官方语言。

sentences.t: Influenced by the *local cultures* and social development, the English language has *changed* little by little over the years.
sentences.zh: 受当地文化和社会发展的影响，英语多年来一点一点地发生了变化。

sentences.t: This has made English *different* from *place* to *place*.
sentences.zh: 这使得英语因地而异。

sentences.t: For‿example, people from *different places* *pronounce* words differently and use different words to mean the *same thing*.
sentences.zh: 例如，不同地方的人发音不同，而且会用不同的词表示同一事物。

sentences.t: Even the *spelling* of words can be *different* from one place to another.
sentences.zh: 甚至单词的拼写也会因地而异。

sentences.t: For‿example, the word "colour" is *British* spelling, while‿it‿is spelled "color" in *American* English.
sentences.zh: 例如，colour 是英式拼写，而在美式英语中拼作 color。

sentences.t: English has‿also *borrowed* words from *other languages* to help with the communication between different cultures.
sentences.zh: 英语还从其他语言中借用了词汇，以帮助不同文化之间的交流。

sentences.t: This makes English *even more popular* with people from different *backgrounds*.
sentences.zh: 这使得英语更受不同背景的人欢迎。

units.name: Unit 5 通往美好世界之路
units.en: A Path Toward a Better World

sentences.t: What technology *project* has *surprised* you most‿in *China*?
sentences.zh: 在中国，哪个科技工程最让你惊讶？

sentences.t: *China* Sky *Eye*.
sentences.zh: 中国天眼。

sentences.t: Can you tell me *more* about‿it?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我多讲讲它吗？

sentences.t: Sure. It‿is the world's *largest* radio *telescope* that scientists use to watch the *sky*.
sentences.zh: 当然。它是世界上最大的射电望远镜，科学家用它来观测天空。

sentences.t: Today, computers have become an *important* part‿of our *lives*.
sentences.zh: 如今，电脑已成为我们生活中重要的一部分。

sentences.t: We use computers for *work*, for *study*, and for *fun*.
sentences.zh: 我们用电脑来工作、学习和娱乐。

sentences.t: We often use the computer to take‿online *courses* and search for *information*.
sentences.zh: 我们经常用电脑上网课和查找信息。

sentences.t: After work‿or study, we can also enjoy *music*, watch *movies*, or chat with *friends* on the computer.
sentences.zh: 工作或学习之余，我们还可以用电脑欣赏音乐、看电影或和朋友聊天。

sentences.t: When we use the computer to do something, it runs‿a *program*.
sentences.zh: 当我们用电脑做某件事时，它就在运行一个程序。

sentences.t: Programs are written by using‿a computer *language* that the computer can *understand*.
sentences.zh: 程序是用计算机能够理解的语言编写的。

sentences.t: They are called computer *languages*.
sentences.zh: 这些语言被称为计算机语言。

sentences.t: You can learn‿a computer *language* and then write your *own* programs.
sentences.zh: 你可以学习一门计算机语言，然后编写自己的程序。

sentences.t: In fact, all the *software* we use every day is *programs*.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们每天使用的所有软件都是程序。

sentences.t: When writing your own programs, you must be very *careful* because‿any *wrong* step will cause the program to *stop*.
sentences.zh: 编写自己的程序时，你必须非常小心，因为任何一个错误的步骤都会导致程序停止运行。

sentences.t: Good *morning*, Kangkang.
sentences.zh: 早上好，康康。

sentences.t: What‿are you *reading*?
sentences.zh: 你在读什么？

sentences.t: I am reading‿a *report* about‿a *high-tech* *restaurant*.
sentences.zh: 我在读一篇关于高科技餐厅的报道。

sentences.t: What‿is a *high-tech* *restaurant*?
sentences.zh: 什么是高科技餐厅？

sentences.t: It's‿a restaurant that uses *robots* to do *all* the jobs.
sentences.zh: 这是一家用机器人来做所有工作的餐厅。

sentences.t: In the restaurant, you *order*‿on your *phone* first.
sentences.zh: 在这家餐厅里，你先用手机点餐。

sentences.t: A *cooking* robot then starts to *cook* the food‿in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 然后，一个烹饪机器人开始在厨房里做饭。

sentences.t: Finally, a *robot* waiter will bring the food to your *table*.
sentences.zh: 最后，一个机器人服务员会把饭菜端到你的桌上。

sentences.t: That sounds‿*amazing*!
sentences.zh: 听起来太神奇了！

sentences.t: Science‿and technology have *certainly* made our lives *easier* and *better*.
sentences.zh: 科学技术确实让我们的生活变得更轻松、更美好了。

sentences.t: You know, I also read‿an *interesting* report‿about *self-driving* cars the other day.
sentences.zh: 你知道吗，前几天我也读了一篇关于自动驾驶汽车的有趣报道。

sentences.t: Oh, what does‿it *say*?
sentences.zh: 哦，报道里说了什么？

sentences.t: Can the cars see *everything* on the road‿and make *correct* driving *decisions*?
sentences.zh: 这些车能看清路上的一切，并做出正确的驾驶决策吗？

sentences.t: *Exactly*. That's why they're called *self-driving* cars.
sentences.zh: 没错。这就是它们被称为自动驾驶汽车的原因。

sentences.t: How *smart* they are!
sentences.zh: 它们真聪明啊！

sentences.t: Does that mean the *risk*‿of car accidents can be greatly *reduced*, even completely *avoided*?
sentences.zh: 这是否意味着车祸的风险可以大大降低，甚至完全避免？

sentences.t: That's *right*.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.t: It's reported that self-driving has passed *strict* road tests‿in China and people can be *freed* from driving in the *near future*.
sentences.zh: 据报道，自动驾驶已在中国通过了严格的道路测试，在不久的将来，人们可以从驾驶中解放出来。

sentences.t: How much do you know about *water-powered* *energy*?
sentences.zh: 你对水力能源了解多少？
sentences.tip: 不完全爆破：about 末尾的 /t/ 只做口型、不爆破，紧接着读 water。

sentences.t: It comes from the *falling* water‿or *running* water.
sentences.zh: 它来自下落的水或流动的水。
sentences.tip: 不完全爆破：It 的 /t/ 后面紧跟 comes 的 /k/，/t/ 只做口型、不爆破。

sentences.t: Can you tell me what *renewable* energies are *made* from?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我可再生能源是由什么形成的吗？
sentences.tip: 不完全爆破：what 的 /t/、made 的 /d/ 后接辅音，只做口型、不爆破；一般疑问句用升调。

sentences.t: They are made from natural resources, like *wind*, *water* and *sunlight*.
sentences.zh: 它们来自自然资源，比如风、水和阳光。
sentences.tip: 不完全爆破：made、wind、and、sunlight 词尾的 /d/ /t/ 后接辅音或在句末时轻读、不爆破。

sentences.t: When New Year's Day comes, buying *presents* is‿an *important* thing for a lot‿of people.
sentences.zh: 元旦到来时，买礼物对很多人来说是一件重要的事。
sentences.tip: 意群停顿：When New Year's Day comes / buying presents / is an important thing / for a lot of people.

sentences.t: However, many people do their *shopping* at *home* instead‿of leaving their houses nowadays.
sentences.zh: 然而，如今许多人都在家购物，而不是出门去买。
sentences.tip: 意群停顿：However / many people do their shopping / at home / instead of leaving their houses / nowadays.

sentences.t: With the help‿of the *internet*, people don't have to line‿up in *busy* shops.
sentences.zh: 在互联网的帮助下，人们不必在拥挤的商店里排队。
sentences.tip: 意群停顿：With the help of the internet / people don't have to line up / in busy shops.

sentences.t: They can buy the products *online*‿at *lower* prices.
sentences.zh: 他们可以在网上以更低的价格购买商品。
sentences.tip: 意群停顿：They can buy the products online / at lower prices.

sentences.t: And they can also get‿*almost* anything they like with just a *few* clicks‿of the mouses.
sentences.zh: 而且只需点几下鼠标，他们几乎可以买到任何想要的东西。
sentences.tip: 意群停顿：And they can also get almost anything / they like / with just a few clicks of the mouses.

sentences.t: It was‿already quite *late* in the afternoon, but Yining's parents were still‿at *work*.
sentences.zh: 已经是下午很晚了，但一宁的父母还在上班。

sentences.t: "Why not try to make *dinner* by *myself*?" Yining said to herself, "I've *seen* mom use Hello Dish many times."
sentences.zh: “为什么不试着自己做晚饭呢？”一宁自言自语道，“我见过妈妈用 Hello Dish 很多次了。”

sentences.t: "Every time mom tried‿a *new* dish, she would‿ask Hello Dish for *help*."
sentences.zh: “每次妈妈尝试做一道新菜时，都会向 Hello Dish 求助。”

sentences.t: Soon Yining started to prepare her *favorite* dishes.
sentences.zh: 很快，一宁开始准备她最喜欢的菜。

sentences.t: While making the dishes, she *asked* Hello Dish *questions* and followed‿its *directions*.
sentences.zh: 做菜时，她向 Hello Dish 提问，并按照它的指示去做。

sentences.t: Everything went‿on quite *well*.
sentences.zh: 一切都进展得很顺利。

sentences.t: When Yining's parents got home, dinner was *ready*.
sentences.zh: 当一宁的父母回到家时，晚饭已经做好了。

sentences.t: The dinner was *simple*, but Yining's parents were greatly *moved* and felt very *proud*‿of her.
sentences.zh: 晚饭很简单，但一宁的父母非常感动，并为她感到十分自豪。

sentences.t: Science, engineering and technology are very *closely* connected, but how are they *different* from one‿another?
sentences.zh: 科学、工程和技术联系非常紧密，但它们彼此之间有什么不同呢？

sentences.t: To make things *clear*, we can start with‿a saying about the differences between science and engineering: Scientists *study* the world‿as‿it is, while engineers *create* the world that has never been.
sentences.zh: 为了把问题说清楚，我们可以从一句关于科学与工程区别的话说起：科学家研究世界的本来面貌，而工程师创造从未存在过的世界。

sentences.t: As to technology, we may then put‿it like this: Technology is the *use*‿of *scientific* knowledge in achieving *engineering* goals.
sentences.zh: 至于技术，我们可以这样说：技术就是运用科学知识来实现工程目标。

sentences.t: Up‿in the *sky*, there are many man-made *inventions* that guide us to go in the right *direction*‿on the Earth.
sentences.zh: 在天空中，有许多人造发明引导我们在地球上朝着正确的方向前进。

sentences.t: Among them, China's *Beidou* Navigation Satellite System (BDS) is one‿of the *best*.
sentences.zh: 其中，中国的北斗卫星导航系统（BDS）是最好的系统之一。

sentences.t: In the early 1980s, the world depended‿on America's *GPS* (Global Positioning System) for *navigation*.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪80年代初，全世界都依赖美国的GPS（全球定位系统）进行导航。

sentences.t: However, in 1994, China decided to develop‿its *own* *system*.
sentences.zh: 然而，1994年，中国决定研发自己的系统。

sentences.t: In the next 10 years, a research‿and development team worked *day* and *night*, doing *experiments*, running tests, and solving technological problems.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的10年里，一支研发团队夜以继日地工作，做实验、进行测试、解决技术难题。

sentences.t: Finally, in 2003, BDS-1 was put‿into *use* and began providing *services* for people in China.
sentences.zh: 终于，在2003年，北斗一号投入使用，开始为中国人民提供服务。

sentences.t: This marked the *beginning* of and the *first* step‿in China's *three-step* BDS strategy.
sentences.zh: 这标志着中国北斗“三步走”战略的开端，也是第一步。

sentences.t: The second step was to include more *countries*‿in China's BDS.
sentences.zh: 第二步是让北斗系统服务更多的国家。

sentences.t: This was‿a *great* aim‿and required even *more* efforts.
sentences.zh: 这是一个宏伟的目标，需要付出更多的努力。

sentences.t: Experienced engineers worked *closely* with *younger* ones, passing‿on *successful* experience and solving the problems one by one.
sentences.zh: 经验丰富的工程师与年轻工程师密切合作，传授成功经验，并逐一解决问题。

sentences.t: In 2012, after *nine* years‿of *hard* work, BDS-2 was *completed*.
sentences.zh: 2012年，经过九年的艰苦努力，北斗二号建成。

sentences.t: Its services covered the *Asia-Pacific*‿area.
sentences.zh: 它的服务覆盖了亚太地区。

sentences.t: Starting‿in 2015, the Chinese scientists aimed to make BDS work *well* at‿a *global* level.
sentences.zh: 从2015年开始，中国科学家致力于让北斗系统在全球范围内良好运行。

sentences.t: To *compete* against Europe‿and America, the Chinese team worked *harder* than‿ever.
sentences.zh: 为了与欧洲和美国竞争，中国团队比以往任何时候都更加努力。

sentences.t: Finally, in 2020, BDS-3 was *completed*‿and began providing services around the *world*.
sentences.zh: 终于，在2020年，北斗三号建成，并开始为全世界提供服务。

sentences.t: China's navigation satellite system is named "*Beidou*" because‿it is the name for the *seven* bright *stars* that‿ancient Chinese used to find their ways.
sentences.zh: 中国的导航卫星系统被命名为“北斗”，因为这是古代中国人用来辨认方向的七颗明亮星星的名字。

sentences.t: In the future, China will *continue* to *improve* BDS and guide the *whole* world to go in the right direction.
sentences.zh: 未来，中国将继续完善北斗系统，引导全世界朝着正确的方向前进。

sentences.t: Virtual *reality* is‿a technology that creates‿a *copy* of the real world‿in a virtual *environment*.
sentences.zh: 虚拟现实是一种在虚拟环境中创建真实世界副本的技术。
sentences.tip: -ity 结尾的单词，重音落在 -ity 前面的音节上：reality /riˈæləti/。

sentences.t: *Creativity* is very *important* in the field‿of *technology*.
sentences.zh: 创造力在科技领域非常重要。
sentences.tip: creativity /ˌkriːeɪˈtɪvəti/ 重音在 -ity 前的 -tiv- 上。

sentences.t: Robots can do almost‿any *activity* that *humans* can do.
sentences.zh: 机器人几乎能做人类能做的任何活动。
sentences.tip: activity /ækˈtɪvəti/ 重音在 -ity 前的 -tiv- 上。

sentences.t: Hello, Kangkang. I have heard that the *high-speed* train can run‿at *350* kilometers an hour.
sentences.zh: 你好，康康。我听说高铁每小时能跑350公里。

sentences.t: Yes, and‿it‿is the *latest* high-speed train that runs between *Shanghai* and *Beijing*.
sentences.zh: 是的，而且这是在上海和北京之间运行的最新型高铁。

sentences.t: Is‿it the *fastest*‿and most *comfortable* train that you have‿ever taken?
sentences.zh: 这是你坐过的最快、最舒适的火车吗？

sentences.t: Yes, it‿is.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.t: I can't wait to take‿it‿again and *experience* the *comfort* and *speed* that the train can offer.
sentences.zh: 我迫不及待想再坐一次，体验这趟列车带来的舒适与速度。
sentences.tip: 课本中此处的 that 带括号，表示这个关系代词可以省略。

sentences.t: Xiao Ya, what do you know about *clean* *energy*?
sentences.zh: 小雅，你对清洁能源了解多少？

sentences.t: You mean, the kind‿of energy that doesn't *pollute* the *environment*?
sentences.zh: 你是说，不污染环境的那种能源吗？

sentences.t: Yeah, like *solar* energy and *wind* energy.
sentences.zh: 对，比如太阳能和风能。
