sentences.t: Well, I know we can produce *electricity* by using *clean* energy technologies.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我知道我们可以利用清洁能源技术发电。

sentences.t: Yes. As‿a matter‿of *fact*, we now have *many* large clean energy *stations*‿in China.
sentences.zh: 是的。事实上，我们中国现在已经有很多大型清洁能源站了。

sentences.t: *Really*? Can you tell me *more* about this?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？你能再跟我多讲讲吗？

sentences.t: For‿example, Inner Mongolia has built China's *largest* *wind* power station.
sentences.zh: 例如，内蒙古建成了中国最大的风力发电站。

sentences.t: *Great*!
sentences.zh: 太棒了！

sentences.t: And‿in Yushu, Qinghai Province, there‿is the world's *largest* *solar* power station.
sentences.zh: 在青海省玉树，有世界上最大的太阳能发电站。

sentences.t: Sounds so *exciting*!
sentences.zh: 听起来真令人兴奋！

sentences.t: And there's *more*.
sentences.zh: 还不止这些呢。

sentences.t: In Xizang, the Yangbajing station is the *first*‿and *largest* power station that uses *underground* heat to produce power in China.
sentences.zh: 在西藏，羊八井电站是中国第一座也是最大的利用地热发电的电站。

sentences.t: Wow! Just think‿of the *possibility* that we will have *endless* clean energy!
sentences.zh: 哇！想想看，我们将拥有取之不尽的清洁能源！

sentences.t: With the *development*‿of clean energy technologies, I'm *sure* this will come‿into *reality* one day.
sentences.zh: 随着清洁能源技术的发展，我相信总有一天这会成为现实。

sentences.t: Science‿and technology are so *amazing*!
sentences.zh: 科学技术真是太神奇了！

sentences.t: My mom is‿a *doctor* and she says that she can't even *imagine* life without all the *cool* things that science and technology give us.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈是一名医生，她说她甚至无法想象，如果没有科学技术带给我们的这些奇妙东西，生活会是什么样子。

sentences.t: Let me tell you about‿a *day* we have.
sentences.zh: 让我给你们讲讲我们的一天吧。

sentences.t: In the morning, my mom prepares *breakfast* for us very *fast*‿in our *modern* kitchen.
sentences.zh: 早上，妈妈在我们的现代化厨房里飞快地为我们准备好早餐。

sentences.t: She then takes me and my brother to *school*.
sentences.zh: 然后她送我和弟弟去上学。

sentences.t: Sometimes there's‿a lot‿of *traffic*, but her phone's *Beidou* System helps‿us find the *best* way to get to school on time.
sentences.zh: 有时路上很堵，但她手机上的北斗系统能帮我们找到最佳路线，按时到校。

sentences.t: When she gets to the *hospital*, she starts seeing her *patients*.
sentences.zh: 她到了医院，就开始给病人看病。

sentences.t: They don't have to wait *long* to see her because the *order*‿of seeing the doctor has‿already been made‿on the *internet*.
sentences.zh: 病人不用等很久就能见到她，因为看病的顺序已经在网上排好了。

sentences.t: Sometimes, she even helps patients over the *phone*‿or *video* calls if they can't come to the *hospital*.
sentences.zh: 有时，如果病人不能来医院，她甚至会通过电话或视频通话帮助他们。

sentences.t: After work, we watch *movies*‿at home on our *big* TV with *amazing* sound.
sentences.zh: 下班后，我们在家用大电视看电影，音效好极了。

sentences.t: We don't even have to go to the *theater*!
sentences.zh: 我们甚至不用去电影院！

sentences.t: We should all be *thankful* for the *benefits* that science and technology bring‿us.
sentences.zh: 我们都应该感谢科学技术给我们带来的好处。

sentences.t: I really *hope* that‿in the *future*, science and technology will keep making the world‿an even *better* place to live‿in.
sentences.zh: 我真心希望，在未来，科学技术能不断让世界成为一个更加美好的居住之地。

sentences.t: The National Ski Jumping Center in Zhangjiakou, Hebei Province, is China's *first* national *ski jumping* center.
sentences.zh: 位于河北省张家口市的国家跳台滑雪中心是中国第一个国家级跳台滑雪中心。

sentences.t: It‿is also known‿as "*Snow Ruyi*", because‿it looks like an *S-shaped* Ruyi, a traditional Chinese symbol that means *good luck*.
sentences.zh: 它也被称为“雪如意”，因为它看起来像一柄S形的如意——一种寓意好运的中国传统吉祥物。

sentences.t: The center proved to be one‿of the most *challenging* engineering projects in the *world*.
sentences.zh: 这个中心被证明是世界上最具挑战性的工程项目之一。

sentences.t: Firstly, it was‿on a *mountain* side, not‿on *flat* ground.
sentences.zh: 首先，它建在山坡上，而不是平地上。

sentences.t: Secondly, the buildings were‿in an *S-shape*, rather than normal *square-shaped* buildings.
sentences.zh: 其次，这些建筑呈S形，而不是普通的方形建筑。

sentences.t: What's more, the main buildings had to be *completed* within‿a *short* period‿of time.
sentences.zh: 此外，主体建筑必须在很短的时间内完工。

sentences.t: However, thanks to the *hard* work‿of the project teams and the use‿of the *latest* engineering technologies, the center was completed just‿in *time* for the Beijing 2022 Winter Olympic Games.
sentences.zh: 然而，多亏了项目团队的辛勤工作和最新工程技术的运用，该中心恰好赶在北京2022年冬奥会之前完工。

sentences.t: Now, as‿a most *modern* ski center, "Snow Ruyi" is both a *training* center‿and a popular *tourist* site.
sentences.zh: 如今，作为一座非常现代化的滑雪中心，“雪如意”既是训练中心，又是热门旅游景点。

sentences.t: Hi, everyone! I'm *Sally*!
sentences.zh: 大家好！我是莎莉！

sentences.t: Welcome to *Sally Talk*.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《莎莉说》节目。

sentences.t: Technology has *changed*‿our lives in many *ways*, especially‿in how we get‿*around*.
sentences.zh: 科技在许多方面改变了我们的生活，尤其是我们的出行方式。

sentences.t: GPS has made *driving* easier by helping‿us find our *way*.
sentences.zh: GPS帮助我们找到路，让开车变得更容易了。

sentences.t: With AI *technology*, there are even *cars* that can drive *themselves*.
sentences.zh: 借助人工智能技术，甚至出现了能自动驾驶的汽车。

sentences.t: *Communication* has‿also been *completely* changed by technology.
sentences.zh: 通信方式也被科技彻底改变了。

sentences.t: We use *mobile* phones to make phone calls, send *texts*‿or have *video* chats with each‿other.
sentences.zh: 我们用手机打电话、发短信或互相视频聊天。

sentences.t: In terms‿of *medicine* and health care, there appeared new *treatments*‿of many diseases, thanks to the new technologies in *biology* and medicine.
sentences.zh: 在医学和医疗保健方面，得益于生物学和医学的新技术，许多疾病有了新的治疗方法。

sentences.t: Just‿a *hundred* years ago, the flu could be *deadly*, but now we have *better* treatments that have saved many lives.
sentences.zh: 仅仅一百年前，流感还可能致命，但现在我们有了更好的治疗方法，挽救了许多生命。

sentences.t: Technology has made‿a *big* *difference* in our lives and will keep *changing* our future.
sentences.zh: 科技给我们的生活带来了巨大的变化，并将继续改变我们的未来。

sentences.t: We should be *prepared* for *new* changes that will be brought by new *technologies*.
sentences.zh: 我们应该为新技术带来的新变化做好准备。

sentences.t: Lingling, *who* do you *admire*?
sentences.zh: 玲玲，你钦佩谁？

sentences.t: I *really* admire *Helen Keller*.
sentences.zh: 我非常钦佩海伦·凯勒。

sentences.t: *Why*?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.t: Although she was *blind*‿and *deaf*, she always remained *positive*‿about life.
sentences.zh: 虽然她既失明又失聪，但她对生活始终保持积极乐观。

sentences.t: I read‿an *article*‿about *Qian Xuesen*.
sentences.zh: 我读了一篇关于钱学森的文章。

sentences.t: He is a *great scientist*.
sentences.zh: 他是一位伟大的科学家。

sentences.t: I *know*!
sentences.zh: 我知道！

sentences.t: He is *honored*‿as "The *Father* of China's *Missiles*‿and Space Program".
sentences.zh: 他被尊称为“中国导弹之父和航天之父”。

sentences.t: He was *born*‿in *1911*‿in *Hangzhou*, Zhejiang Province.
sentences.zh: 他1911年出生于浙江省杭州市。

sentences.t: He *graduated* from Shanghai Jiao Tong University in 1929 and then went to *America* for *further education*‿in 1935.
sentences.zh: 他1929年毕业于上海交通大学，1935年赴美国深造。

sentences.t: Do you know *why* he *returned* to China?
sentences.zh: 你知道他为什么回到中国吗？

sentences.t: He had such a *deep love* for our country that he *gave‿up everything*‿in America and returned‿in 1955.
sentences.zh: 他深爱着我们的祖国，于是放弃了在美国的一切，在1955年回国。

sentences.t: In 1956, he then set‿up China's *first rocket*‿and *missile* research institute.
sentences.zh: 1956年，他创建了中国第一个火箭和导弹研究机构。

sentences.t: Now, we are one‿of the *leading nations*‿in *space* programs.
sentences.zh: 如今，我们已是航天领域的领先国家之一。

sentences.t: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.t: Since Shenzhou 5, every *taikonaut* returning from *space* would *visit* him to show their *respect* to him.
sentences.zh: 从神舟五号开始，每一位从太空归来的航天员都会去看望他，向他表达敬意。

sentences.t: This *tradition* continued‿until he *passed‿away*‿in 2009.
sentences.zh: 这个传统一直延续到他2009年去世。

sentences.t: He is *truly* a *hero* of *heroes*.
sentences.zh: 他真是英雄中的英雄。

sentences.t: Lingling, *who* is the *hero* you *admire*?
sentences.zh: 玲玲，你钦佩的英雄是谁？

sentences.t: *Nan Rendong*.
sentences.zh: 南仁东。

sentences.t: He is‿a *Chinese scientist* who is called the *Father* of *FAST*.
sentences.zh: 他是一位被称为“中国天眼之父”的中国科学家。

sentences.t: What's the *FAST*?
sentences.zh: FAST是什么？

sentences.t: It's the world's *largest telescope*‿and it's‿also known‿as China's *Sky Eye*.
sentences.zh: 它是世界上最大的射电望远镜，也被称为“中国天眼”。

sentences.t: What‿is‿it *used* for?
sentences.zh: 它是用来做什么的？

sentences.t: It‿is used to *observe* the *universe*.
sentences.zh: 它用来观测宇宙。

sentences.t: It can *receive signals* from stars that‿are *10 billion* light years‿away.
sentences.zh: 它能接收来自100亿光年以外的恒星的信号。

sentences.t: How *wonderful*!
sentences.zh: 太了不起了！

sentences.t: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.t: Nan Rendong spent‿about *22 years*‿on this *project* to make‿it what it is today.
sentences.zh: 南仁东为这个项目花了大约22年，才使它成为今天的样子。

sentences.t: What‿about *you*, Xiao Ya?
sentences.zh: 你呢，小雅？

sentences.t: *Marie Curie*.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·居里。

sentences.t: She was the *first woman* to win the *Nobel Prize*, and she won the award *twice*‿in two *different fields*!
sentences.zh: 她是第一位获得诺贝尔奖的女性，而且她在两个不同的领域两次获奖！

sentences.t: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.t: She was‿awarded the 1903 Nobel Prize for *Physics*‿and the 1911 Nobel Prize for *Chemistry*.
sentences.zh: 她获得了1903年诺贝尔物理学奖和1911年诺贝尔化学奖。

sentences.t: And her *research*‿also helped with the *development*‿of *X-ray machines*.
sentences.zh: 而且她的研究还推动了X光机的发展。

sentences.t: With those machines, doctors could *examine* patients *easily* and *saved*‿a lot‿of soldiers during World War II.
sentences.zh: 有了这些机器，医生能够轻松地给病人做检查，在第二次世界大战期间挽救了许多士兵。

sentences.t: She was *really* one‿of the *greatest scientists*‿in human history!
sentences.zh: 她真是人类历史上最伟大的科学家之一！

sentences.t: *Strive not* to be a *success*, but rather to be of *value*.
sentences.zh: 不要为成功而努力，而要为做一个有价值的人而努力。
sentences.tip: 重读实词（strive, not, success, value），虚词 to, a, of, but 弱读

sentences.t: Keep your *face*‿always toward the *sunshine*, and *shadows* will fall behind you.
sentences.zh: 永远面向阳光，阴影就会被你甩在身后。
sentences.tip: your, the, and 弱读；face always 连读

sentences.t: Everyone *thinks*‿of *changing* the *world*, but no one thinks‿of changing himself.
sentences.zh: 每个人都想改变世界，却没有人想改变自己。
sentences.tip: thinks of 连读；of, the, but 弱读

sentences.t: In the *company* of *two* others, I can‿always find‿one *worthy* of being my *teacher*.
sentences.zh: 三人行，必有我师焉。
sentences.tip: can 弱读为 /kən/；company of、find one 连读

sentences.t: More than *2,000 years*‿ago, *Confucius* said, "A *youth*‿is to be *regarded* with *respect*.
sentences.zh: 两千多年前，孔子说：“后生可畏。

sentences.zh: 焉知来者之不如今也？”
sentences.tip: that her、not be 中 /t/ 失去爆破；present 词尾 /t/ 轻读

sentences.t: Youth‿are like the *young trees* thriving‿on earth that will eventually *grow* into *towering* trees, and provide shelter for those‿in *need*.
sentences.zh: 青年就像大地上茁壮成长的小树，终将长成参天大树，为需要的人遮风挡雨。
sentences.tip: like the 中 /k/、and provide 中 /d/ 失去爆破；thriving on earth 连读

sentences.t: They are like the *rising sun* whose *energy* keeps‿on *increasing*, and they will *light*‿and *warm*‿up the earth one day.
sentences.zh: 他们又像冉冉升起的太阳，能量不断增强，终有一天会照亮并温暖大地。
sentences.tip: light and、warm up 连读；keeps on 连读

sentences.t: "*Failure*‿is the *mother*‿of *success*.
sentences.zh: “失败是成功之母。

sentences.t: It doesn't *matter* this *time*.
sentences.zh: 这次没关系。

sentences.t: I will *finally succeed* one day."
sentences.zh: 总有一天我会成功的。”

sentences.t: *Qi Jiguang* was‿a *national hero* in the mid-late *Ming Dynasty*.
sentences.zh: 戚继光是明朝中后期的一位民族英雄。

sentences.t: He *joined* the army at‿a *young age*‿and *fought* many times‿in his life.
sentences.zh: 他年少从军，一生征战无数。

sentences.t: He was‿a *talented general* who also *wrote books*‿about the art‿of war.
sentences.zh: 他是一位有才能的将领，还撰写过兵法著作。

sentences.t: At the same time, he was *good*‿at *training soldiers*.
sentences.zh: 同时，他擅长练兵。

sentences.t: He trained‿a *strong army* and led‿it to *fight*‿against the *enemies* that came across the sea from Japan.
sentences.zh: 他训练出一支强大的军队，率领他们抗击从海上来犯的日本倭寇。

sentences.t: His‿army was *honored*‿as the "*Army* of *Qi*" in Chinese history.
sentences.zh: 他的军队在中国历史上被誉为“戚家军”。

sentences.t: *Isaac Newton* was‿a *great scientist*‿in *physics*.
sentences.zh: 艾萨克·牛顿是一位伟大的物理学家。

sentences.t: He had been *curious*‿about *nature*‿ever since he was‿a boy.
sentences.zh: 他从小就对大自然充满好奇。

sentences.t: He *often*‿asked *questions*‿about what he saw.
sentences.zh: 他经常对自己看到的事物提出问题。

sentences.t: We've‿all heard the *story* of‿an *apple* falling down‿on his *head* when he was sitting under an apple tree.
sentences.zh: 我们都听说过这样一个故事：他坐在苹果树下时，一个苹果掉下来砸在了他的头上。

sentences.t: He *wondered* why things fell *straight down*, instead‿of going‿up‿or in any other direction.
sentences.zh: 他想知道为什么东西会直直地往下掉，而不是往上或往其他任何方向。

sentences.t: In searching‿of the *answer* to this question, he later *discovered* the *law* why planets move‿in‿a circle around the sun.
sentences.zh: 在寻找这个问题答案的过程中，他后来发现了行星绕太阳做圆周运动的定律。

sentences.t: *Tu Youyou* is the *first Chinese woman* to receive the *Nobel Prize*.
sentences.zh: 屠呦呦是第一位获得诺贝尔奖的中国女性。

sentences.t: After years‿of *hard work*, her *greatness* was *finally recognized* by the world.
sentences.zh: 经过多年的艰苦努力，她的伟大终于得到了世界的认可。

sentences.t: She was *born*‿in *1930*‿in *Zhejiang* Province.
sentences.zh: 她1930年出生于浙江省。

sentences.t: She got her *name* from‿a *Chinese poem* meaning "*deer call*".
sentences.zh: 她的名字取自一首中国古诗，意为“鹿鸣”。

sentences.t: In her‿early *twenties*, Tu studied *medicine*‿at Beijing Medical College and developed a *strong interest*‿in *herbal medicine*.
sentences.zh: 二十出头时，屠呦呦在北京医学院学习医学，并对草药产生了浓厚的兴趣。

sentences.t: In the 1960s, many people were *suffering* from‿a *serious disease* which took‿away lots‿of people's *lives*.
sentences.zh: 20世纪60年代，许多人饱受一种严重疾病的折磨，这种病夺去了很多人的生命。

sentences.t: In 1969, as a researcher who studied both *Chinese medicine*‿and *Western medicine*, Tu became the *head*‿of a research team that focused‿on treating the disease.
sentences.zh: 1969年，作为一名既研究中医又研究西医的研究员，屠呦呦成为一个专门研究治疗这种疾病的研究小组的组长。

sentences.t: Tu and her team took‿a *creative method* by going back to *Traditional Chinese medicine* books.
sentences.zh: 屠呦呦和她的团队采用了一种创新的方法——回到中医古籍中寻找答案。

sentences.t: The team did *hundreds*‿of *experiments*.
sentences.zh: 团队做了数百次实验。

sentences.t: *Unluckily*, they all *failed*.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，这些实验都失败了。

sentences.t: However, Tu *didn't give‿up*.
sentences.zh: 然而，屠呦呦没有放弃。

sentences.t: She looked‿up *classical* Chinese medicine books‿and *finally found*‿a way to *develop* the drug.
sentences.zh: 她查阅了中医经典古籍，终于找到了研制这种药物的方法。

sentences.t: To help put the drug‿into use *quickly*, Tu and two other workers *volunteered* to *test* the new drug‿on *themselves*.
sentences.zh: 为了让这种药物尽快投入使用，屠呦呦和另外两名工作人员自愿在自己身上试药。

sentences.t: Since then, the drug has *saved millions*‿of *lives*‿in South Asia, Africa and America.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，这种药物在南亚、非洲和美洲挽救了数百万人的生命。

sentences.t: As the *developer*‿of the drug, Tu is *still working*‿on *exploring* traditional Chinese medicine‿and introducing it to the world.
sentences.zh: 作为这种药物的研制者，屠呦呦至今仍在致力于探索中医药，并把它介绍给全世界。

sentences.t: My *grandfather* needs‿a tool to help him *enlarge* the words‿in the *newspaper*.
sentences.zh: 我爷爷需要一个工具来帮他放大报纸上的字。

sentences.t: Parents‿always *encourage* kids to *join*‿in *challenging* activities.
sentences.zh: 父母总是鼓励孩子参加有挑战性的活动。

sentences.t: We can *enjoy beautiful pictures*‿on the internet.
sentences.zh: 我们可以在网上欣赏漂亮的图片。

sentences.t: Miss Wang, *what* do you *know* about *Confucius*?
sentences.zh: 王老师，您对孔子了解多少？

sentences.t: He was‿a *great thinker* who had many *wise ideas*‿about how to *behave* well.
sentences.zh: 他是一位伟大的思想家，对如何做人有许多睿智的见解。

sentences.t: He was *really* a *great man* from whom we can *learn*‿a lot.
sentences.zh: 他真是一位值得我们好好学习的伟人。

sentences.t: Of *course*.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.t: He was‿also‿a *famous teacher* who had many *famous students*.
sentences.zh: 他还是一位著名的老师，有很多著名的学生。

sentences.t: In my eyes, *cleaners*‿are *great people*.
sentences.zh: 在我眼里，清洁工是伟大的人。

sentences.t: They are those who get‿up *earliest*‿every *morning*‿in the city.
sentences.zh: 他们是城市里每天早上起得最早的人。

sentences.t: They keep the city *clean*‿and *beautiful*‿every day.
sentences.zh: 他们每天让城市保持干净美丽。

sentences.t: And *most*‿of‿all, they do the *same cleaning* day after *day* ...
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，他们日复一日地做着同样的清洁工作……

sentences.t: Kangkang, your *painting*‿is *beautiful*!
sentences.zh: 康康，你的画真漂亮！

sentences.t: *Thank* you, Lingling.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，玲玲。

sentences.t: I *learned*‿it from my *neighbor*, grandpa *Liu*.
sentences.zh: 我是跟我的邻居刘爷爷学的。

sentences.t: He is‿a *talented painter*.
sentences.zh: 他是一位很有才华的画家。

sentences.t: Oh, *really*?
sentences.zh: 哦，真的吗？

sentences.t: Can you *tell* me *more*?
sentences.zh: 你能多给我讲讲吗？

sentences.t: He *once* held many *art shows*‿around *China*.
sentences.zh: 他曾经在全国各地举办过许多画展。

sentences.t: *Unluckily*, he had‿a *car accident*‿a few years‿ago.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，几年前他出了一场车祸。

sentences.t: How *terrible* that‿is!
sentences.zh: 太可怕了！

sentences.t: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.t: He *lost* his *legs*‿in the accident.
sentences.zh: 他在事故中失去了双腿。

sentences.t: But he's been *very positive*‿about *life*.
sentences.zh: 但他一直对生活非常乐观。

sentences.t: *What* did he do after *that*?
sentences.zh: 那之后他做了什么？

sentences.t: He *volunteered* to *teach* the *children*‿in the community.
sentences.zh: 他自愿教社区里的孩子们。

sentences.t: You're *lucky* to have such‿a *good teacher*.
sentences.zh: 你有这么好的老师真幸运。

sentences.t: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.t: We all *love* him‿and *admire* him.
sentences.zh: 我们都爱戴他、钦佩他。

sentences.t: *Indeed*!
sentences.zh: 确实！

sentences.t: He is not‿only‿an *excellent painter*, but‿also a *hero*.
sentences.zh: 他不仅是一位优秀的画家，还是一位英雄。

sentences.t: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.t: We should *learn* from him to be *positive*‿about life‿and *helpful* to people‿around us.
sentences.zh: 我们应该向他学习，积极乐观地面对生活，乐于帮助身边的人。

sentences.t: There will be a *volunteer activity* in my community this *weekend*.
sentences.zh: 这个周末我们社区有一个志愿者活动。

sentences.t: Can you *go* with *me*?
sentences.zh: 你能和我一起去吗？

sentences.t: *Sure*.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.t: For me, the person I *admire most*‿is *Huang Wenxiu*, a woman who gave her *life* to *fighting*‿against *poverty* in the countryside.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我最钦佩的人是黄文秀，一位把生命献给农村脱贫攻坚事业的女性。

sentences.t: In 1989, Huang Wenxiu was *born*‿in‿a *poor village*‿in *Guangxi*.
sentences.zh: 1989年，黄文秀出生在广西的一个贫困村庄。

sentences.t: She *dreamed*‿of studying‿at‿a *good university*.
sentences.zh: 她梦想着能上一所好大学。

sentences.t: In 2016, she *graduated* with‿a *master's degree* from Beijing Normal University.
sentences.zh: 2016年，她从北京师范大学硕士研究生毕业。

sentences.t: However, instead‿of settling down‿in a *big city*, Huang *chose* to go back to her *hometown village*, and worked‿as a village *Party secretary*.
sentences.zh: 然而，她没有选择留在大城市，而是回到家乡的村子，担任村党支部书记。

sentences.t: She spent *two months* visiting *195 poor families*‿across the village.
sentences.zh: 她花了两个月走访了全村195户贫困家庭。

sentences.t: Many villagers *doubted* Huang's‿*ability*.
sentences.zh: 许多村民怀疑黄文秀的能力。

sentences.t: Huang showed *great patience*‿and *creativity* to prove herself.
sentences.zh: 黄文秀展现出极大的耐心和创造力来证明自己。

sentences.t: She invited *experts* to teach the villagers to grow *orange trees*.
sentences.zh: 她请来专家教村民种植橘子树。

sentences.t: Besides, she *guided* the villagers to make‿use‿of *online platforms* to *sell* the products.
sentences.zh: 此外，她还指导村民利用网络平台销售产品。

sentences.t: Some years later, a *great many families* were *lifted*‿out‿of *poverty*.
sentences.zh: 几年后，许多家庭摆脱了贫困。

sentences.t: In the summer‿of 2019, a *flood* took Huang's *life* when she was‿at *work*.
sentences.zh: 2019年夏天，一场洪水在她工作时夺去了她的生命。

sentences.t: However, Huang's *spirit* will *never die*.
sentences.zh: 然而，黄文秀的精神永不消逝。

sentences.t: I *hope* one day I can‿also do something to *help people*‿around me, just like my *hero* Huang Wenxiu.
sentences.zh: 我希望有一天我也能做些事情去帮助身边的人，就像我心目中的英雄黄文秀一样。

sentences.t: *Xu Haifeng*‿is‿a *famous* Chinese *Olympic medalist*.
sentences.zh: 许海峰是中国著名的奥运奖牌得主。

sentences.t: He is the *first* Chinese‿athlete who won‿an *Olympic gold medal*‿in history.
sentences.zh: 他是中国历史上第一位获得奥运金牌的运动员。

sentences.t: Xu was *born*‿on *August 1st*, *1957*.
sentences.zh: 许海峰出生于1957年8月1日。

sentences.t: At‿an *early age*, he started to show *great love*‿and *talent* for *shooting*.
sentences.zh: 他从小就对射击表现出极大的热爱和天赋。

sentences.t: As‿a *country boy* from‿a *poor family*, he only had *homemade guns* to practice shooting.
sentences.zh: 作为一个出身贫寒的农村孩子，他只有自制的枪来练习射击。

sentences.t: However, he trained *very hard* to develop his *skills*‿as‿a shooter even though he had *no coach*.
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管没有教练，他仍刻苦训练，提高自己的射击技术。

sentences.t: *Finally* in 1982, Xu *joined* the *shooting team*‿of‿Anhui Province.
sentences.zh: 终于在1982年，许海峰加入了安徽省射击队。

sentences.t: Two years later, he started his *sports career*‿in the *national team*.
sentences.zh: 两年后，他在国家队开始了自己的体育生涯。

sentences.t: *Luck* helps those who are *prepared*.
sentences.zh: 机会总是留给有准备的人。

sentences.t: In 1984, Xu Haifeng took the *gold medal*‿in the *shooting event*‿in the 1984 *Los Angeles Olympics*.
sentences.zh: 1984年，许海峰在洛杉矶奥运会射击项目中夺得金牌。

sentences.t: After that, he *continued* to win *gold medals*‿at the *Asian Games*‿of 1986‿and 1990.
sentences.zh: 此后，他又在1986年和1990年的亚运会上获得金牌。

sentences.t: Xu Haifeng's‿*achievements* go *beyond*‿an‿athlete.
sentences.zh: 许海峰的成就远不止于一名运动员。

sentences.t: He also served‿as the *coach*‿of Chinese shooting team‿and *encouraged younger players* to aim for *excellence*.
sentences.zh: 他还担任过中国射击队的教练，鼓励年轻选手追求卓越。

sentences.t: Just‿as his nicknames‿of "*Gold Athlete*" and "*Gold Coach*" suggest, he is‿a *sports hero* who will never be forgotten.
sentences.zh: 正如他“金牌运动员”和“金牌教练”的称号所表明的，他是一位永远不会被遗忘的体育英雄。

sentences.t: In‿a word, Xu's *story* is‿a *victory* both for *himself*‿and the *country*.
sentences.zh: 总之，许海峰的故事是他个人的胜利，也是国家的胜利。

sentences.t: *Florence Nightingale* was the *founder*‿of *modern nursing*.
sentences.zh: 弗洛伦斯·南丁格尔是现代护理学的创始人。

sentences.t: She was *born*‿in‿a *rich British family* on *May 12th*, 1820.
sentences.zh: 她于1820年5月12日出生在英国一个富裕的家庭。

sentences.t: From‿a *very young age*, Nightingale was *active*‿in *helping* the poor‿and the sick around her neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 南丁格尔从很小的时候起，就积极帮助她家附近的穷人和病人。

sentences.t: In 1844, she went to *study nursing*‿in *Germany* and later became‿a *nurse*.
sentences.zh: 1844年，她去德国学习护理，后来成为一名护士。

sentences.t: In 1854, she *organized* a group‿of more than *30 nurses*‿and led them to *care* for the *wounded soldiers*‿in war hospitals.
sentences.zh: 1854年，她组织了一支30多人的护士队伍，带领她们到战地医院照顾受伤的士兵。

sentences.t: She worked‿in *very difficult conditions* for more than‿a *year*.
sentences.zh: 她在非常艰苦的条件下工作了一年多。

sentences.t: Because she always carried‿a *lamp* to see her *patients*‿at *night*, she became known‿as "the *Lady* with the *Lamp*".
sentences.zh: 因为她晚上总是提着一盏灯去看望病人，所以她被称为“提灯女士”。

sentences.t: After the war, Nightingale *opened* the world's *first nursing school*‿and continued to care for patients‿as‿a nurse.
sentences.zh: 战争结束后，南丁格尔开办了世界上第一所护士学校，并继续作为一名护士照顾病人。

sentences.t: She became *well-known worldwide*, and many *young women* followed her‿*example* to become‿a nurse.
sentences.zh: 她闻名世界，许多年轻女性以她为榜样，成为了护士。

sentences.t: Nightingale *died*‿in *1910*‿at the age‿of *90*.
sentences.zh: 南丁格尔于1910年去世，享年90岁。

sentences.t: To *honor* her *contributions* to health care, her *birthday* became the *International Nurses' Day* in 1912.
sentences.zh: 为了纪念她对医疗卫生事业的贡献，1912年她的生日被定为国际护士节。
